desc: The user unleashes a powerful wave of corrupting energy, dealing Dark property Magic damage in a 9x9 area with a chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds. The user restores 15 SP per level for each Void Sphere they have when cast. If Void Infusion: Dark is active, this skill's cooldown is halved. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point each of Vitality and Luck. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Summons a comet from the Abyss, dropping it on a distant target to consume all of the user's Void Spheres and deal Dark property damage of 500% + 30% per level for each sphere consumed, inflicting the Burning status for 5 seconds (100% chance) across a 9x9 area. The user restores 20% of Max SP for each Void Sphere consumed. If Void Infusion: Dark is active, this skill's Fixed Cast Time is removed. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point each of Vitality and Luck. Has a cast time of 4s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Abyssal Comet.requires: Abyssal Flare Lv5, Abyssal Burst Lv5

desc: Unleashes a burst of flame laced with dark magic, dealing Dark property Magic damage to a single target with a high chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds. If the target is already Burning, the user restores 3% of Max SP per level. Each cast has a chance to summon one Void Sphere; if Void Infusion: Dark is active, that chance is doubled. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point each of Vitality and Luck. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Throws a mix of volatile chemicals that react violently upon striking the target, exploding in a 7x7 cloud of acidic gas. The damage dealt by the gas is increased by the user's Vulnerable Potency and by Intelligence (2% per point). For each Extort stack the user has, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1 second (base 10 seconds). Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Throws a mixture of chemicals at a distant target which explode violently on contact, dealing incredible damage based on the user's Extort stacks. The skill misses if the user has none, and gains bonus effects based on the number consumed:

* 1: Inflicts Vulnerable for 10 seconds. * 2: Damage is increased by the user's Vulnerable Potency. * 3: Inflicts Burning for 10 seconds. * 4: Damage is treated as Burning Damage. * 5: Extort stacks are not consumed.
Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Intelligence. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Acid Demonstration.requires: Incinerate Lv5, Acid Cloud Lv5, Alchemic Cannon Lv5

desc: Throws a vial of acid at an enemy, dealing ranged physical damage with a chance to damage their armor and inflict the Vulnerable status. The Vulnerable chance is increased by an additional 3% per level of Chemical Research. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Intelligence. Generates one stack of Extort when cast.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Activates the Madogear's defensive shielding, creating a Barrier for 5 seconds with HP equal to (100 per skill level + 100 per Madogear Construction level) per Extort stack. Normally consumes all Extort stacks; if a Madogear is currently active, the stacks are counted but not consumed. If the user is in Overdrive, the Barrier is always created at maximum strength.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
The user calls on a purging light to cleanse the targeted area of all foes. Deals Holy Property Magic Damage to the target and all enemies in a 7x7 area around them.
* Grace: consumes the status to inflict the Slow and Blind statuses. * Authority: consumes the status to inflict the Breach and Vulnerable statuses.

Statuses are inflicted at a 100% chance and last 5 seconds. This skill does not take the skill level of the user's Grace or Authority status. This skill deals additional damage equal to 3% Matk per point of Luk.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.
The user enters a semi-berserk state, increasing their Attack Speed and Hit Rate for 5 minutes. Requires an Axe or Two-Handed Axe.
Costs 30 SP at all levels.
Training in the use of Advanced Ninja Arts. Each level learned increases the damage of Blazing Dragon, Winter's Grasp, Thunderous Surge, and Seismic Collapse.
Training in the advanced deployment of traps. Increases the duration of Ranger traps, and increases the range at which all traps can be placed.

Commands the Falcon to strike a distant target, dealing Neutral property damage that ignores Defense and extends the duration of Bleeding, Burning, and Poison on them. Deals 30% additional damage if the target is Slowed. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Agility. Requires a Falcon. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on spirits of fire to infuse the ground with supernatural heat across a 9x9 area, dealing Burning-equivalent damage to all enemies within every second; this damage stacks separately with the Burning status, and is increased by 1% per point of the user's Summoned Entity HP bonus. If Ardor (Summon Ardor) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use a Support Skill. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on spirits of fire to incinerate their foes, dealing Fire property damage in a 7x7 area around the target. The damage is increased by the user's bonuses to Summoned Entity Damage, and by 2% MATK per point of Luck. If Ardor (Summon Ardor) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use an Attack Skill. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Throws a specially crafted potion at an ally, instantly triggering its healing effects. The amount healed is improved by the target's Vit and the learned level of Aid Potion, regardless of what level is cast. Throwable potions can be crafted at the Alchemist's Guild, and are not consumed. When targeting a Homunculus above level 100, the healing amount is increased by 1% per level of the target above 100. Requires Shift + Click or /ns to target a Homunculus.

Uses alchemical reactions to fire a projectile at devastating speed toward the target, exploding on contact and dealing damage in a 7x7 area with 30% additional final damage per status against Vulnerable and Burning enemies. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Intelligence. For each Extort stack the user has, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1 second (base 10 seconds). Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Coats the target's weapon with an alchemical agent that improves its efficacy, increasing the target's Attack, Magic Attack, Defense Pierce, and Magic Defense Pierce. Defense and Magic Defense Pierce are increased by 3% per level of Enhancement Research. Shift + Click to apply to Homunculi.
Costs 20 SP at all levels.
Alchemical Weapon.requires: Synthetic Shield Lv3, Energized Armor Lv3

desc: The user jumps out from Hiding, dealing damage to enemies across a 7x7 area and attempting to inflict the Blind and Vulnerable statuses. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity. Requires the Hiding or Cloaking status.
Has a base cooldown of 2 seconds at all levels.

The user taps into their hidden stockpile of grenades, preparing them for use in combat. Immediately generates a number of Grenades for use with Grenade Launcher skills. Grenades last for 60 seconds before disappearing, regardless of how they were obtained.
This skill is not included in the skill count for Grenade Launcher Mastery.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Delivers a savage blow to a single enemy, dealing exceptional damage that takes advantage of the enemy's statuses. For each of Bleeding, Burning, and Poison the enemy is suffering from, the damage is increased by 30% final damage and the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds. If all three statuses are present, the enemy is additionally Stunned for 2 seconds (100% chance). Damage is increased by 5% ATK per point of Luck.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels, reduced by 5 seconds per status present.
Annihilate.requires: Ricochet Knife Lv5, Scorpion Lash Lv5, Fire Cracker Lv5

desc: Enchants the ground at the targeted location with negative magic, reducing the effectiveness of all magic in the area for 10 seconds. Anyone standing in the field, friend or foe, receives 80% less damage from Magical Attacks and becomes immune to the Burning, Chilled, and Sleep statuses. Only one Land Spell can be active at a time. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 2s VCT.
Costs 200 SP at all levels.
Antimagic Field.requires: Elemental Mastery Lv5, Spell Eater Lv1, Transposition Spell Lv1

desc: The user calls on spirits of water to freeze their foes, dealing Water property damage in a 7x7 targeted area. The damage is increased by the user's bonuses to Summoned Entity Damage, and by 2% MATK per point of Vit. If Diluvio (Summon Diluvio) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use an Attack Skill. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on spirits of water to provide relief and healing, summoning a gentle rain over a 9x9 area for 5 seconds that heals all friendly creatures within every second. The healing is increased by the user's bonuses to Summoned Entity HP. If Diluvio (Summon Diluvio) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use a Support Skill. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user calls a divine light from Heaven to scour the targeted enemy from existence. Deals single target Holy Property Magic damage that has a chance to inflict the Searing Light status for 5 seconds.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% Matk per point of Luk.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds, reduced by 1 second per level of Divine Authority. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.

Invites the soul of an ancient, powerful mystic to inhabit the user's body, drawing on a portion of their knowledge. For 5 minutes, converts a portion of the user's Physical Attack into Magic Attack, reduces the user's Variable Cast Time by 0.5% per point of Str, and increases their SP Regen by 1% per point of Vit. Only one Possession can be active at a time. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user sings an energizing melody, inspiring their party to quicker and safer movement. Consumes all of the user's Rhythm to provide massive buffs to Movement Speed, Flee, and Perfect Dodge for all party members in a 31x31 area. The buff lasts 60 seconds per Rhythm level consumed. Does not stack with Hero's Hymn. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 90 seconds at all levels.
Ardent Anthem.requires: Bard: Quickening Chorus Lv5, Darkening Dirge Lv5 / Dancer: Wearying Waltz Lv5, Savage Stride Lv5

desc: The user chants an inspiring prayer, bolstering the spirits of their party members. Increases the Attack and Magic Attack of all party members for the duration, with an additional 1 Atk/Matk per 10 points of the user's Vit. Lasts 30 seconds, plus 3 seconds per level of Divine Authority.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.

Fires the Madogear's cannon to obliterate a distant target up to 9 cells away, dealing Ranged Physical damage with 30% additional final damage if the target is Stunned or Staggered. If the user is in Overdrive, also inflicts the Severe Burning and Vulnerable statuses for 5 seconds (100% chance). Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Vitality. Costs 3 Extort stacks (waived while a Madogear is active). Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Passively increases the user's physical Defense while not wearing a shield.

Combines certain materials to create an Armor Modification device. These modifications can be applied to most armor, overwriting its Random Options and replacing them with more focused bonuses. The level of this skill improves the effectiveness of Armor Modifications for the user, but has no effect on success rate or the quality of rolls received. Each craft succeeds 100% of the time and produces 1 to 5 devices at random. Recipes for Armor Modifications must be found in the world.

Reinforces the party's armor, providing a different beneficial effect depending on the level used. Using this skill above level 1 requires an Armor Maintenance Kit crafted at the Blacksmith's Guild. Regardless of what level of the skill is cast, the max level learned is used to determine the skill's potency.
Costs 10 SP at all levels.

rows: Hard Defense +10 per skill level; Soft Defense +4 per Equipment Maintenance level

desc: Fires a blunt, heavy arrow that will knock the target back.
10 second cooldown at all levels.
Fires a cluster of arrows at the targeted location, knocking back enemies in the area.
Has a cooldown of 5s and an SP cost of 15 at all levels.

Fires a rapid barrage of numerous arrows at the target, striking them and all enemies in a 9x9 area for massive damage. All enemies struck are left Slowed and Vulnerable for 5 seconds (100% chance). Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point each of Strength and Luck. For each Preparation Counter the user has, this skill's cast time is reduced by 1s FCT + 1s VCT and its damage is increased (10%/25%/50% final damage at 1/2/3 Counters); all Preparation Counters are then lost. This skill requires at least one Preparation Counter to cast. Has a base cast time of 5s FCT + 5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Arrow Storm.requires: Piercing Shot Lv5, Razor Shot Lv5

desc: The user draws a cursed mark on the target, inflaming their Burning status. If the target is not suffering from Burning, inflicts the status for 5 seconds. If they are, the mark ignites, dealing Burning damage every second to all enemies in a 7x7 area around the target, including the target themselves. If Chaser's Instinct is active, each time the mark inflicts damage it has a chance to inflict the Burning status. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Endows the weapons of all party members with the Holy property. For each level of Divine Grace known by the caster, Holy damage dealt by those affected is increased by 1%. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

The user infuses their weapon with holy might, giving all of their normal attacks a chance to inflict double damage for the duration. If this skill is mastered, it passively reduces the cooldown of Assault Stance by 10 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user shifts into an offensive stance for 5 seconds, improving their Crit Rate and maximum Attack Speed, but preventing the use of all skills. When the stance ends, a burst attack is triggered that strikes all enemies around the user for damage based on how much damage the user inflicted during the stance.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Issues a command to all active drones in a 31x31 area to shift into an all-out offensive mode. Nearby Drones enter a Berserk state, gaining new skills for 5 seconds, while the user and their allies gain increased Attack, plus Defense Pierce of 3% per level of Drone Construction. Costs 3 Extort stacks (waived while no Madogear is active). Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

The user smashes an enemy with their weapon, dealing Weapon property Physical damage to a single target. Has a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds, at 50% chance plus 5% per level of Divine Authority. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Dexterity.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Throws an axe at a distance target, inflicting damage with a chance to Stun for 2 seconds. When casted at even levels, also knocks the target back 4 cells. 5 second cooldown.
Delivers a staggering blow to the enemy's head, leaving the target stunned for 1.5 seconds.
Using this skill grants the Axe Stance for 5 seconds, during which time all kicks inflict various status effects. Axe stance ends when any other Stance ends or when Axe Kick is cast again.
Axe Kick.requires: Martial Endurance Lv3, Martial Precision Lv3

desc: Increases accuracy and damage with one-handed and two-handed axes.

The user spins like a tornado, shredding any enemies that get close with their axe. If the user has any Extort stacks, all of them are consumed to deal an additional 100% ATK per stack, and the attack is guaranteed to be Critical. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Vitality. Requires an Axe or Two-Handed Axe.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Axe Tornado.requires: Hammer Fall Lv3, Rush Down Lv3

desc: Rapidly dodges backward 7 cells to avoid enemy attacks, has a lengthy cooldown which is reduced by level.
Costs 7 SP at all levels.

Quickly jumps behind the target and delivers a lethal blow where they least expect it. Deals 50% additional final damage if the target is Blind, and 50% additional final damage if they are Vulnerable. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Dexterity. This skill can be cast from Hiding.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Summons a holy light to strike the target, attempting to cast them back to the wicked realm they came from. Deals 100% increased damage to enemies of the Angel, Demon, or Undead races; this bonus is applied partially to enemies of other races, at 10% final damage per level of Divine Authority learned. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user infuses their weapon with holy energy and strikes the enemy, dealing Weapon property Physical damage with 30% additional final damage against Demon, Undead, and Angel race enemies. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity.

* During Castigating Aura, the racial bonus is applied to all races, and the skill inflicts the Bleeding status for 5 seconds (100% chance). * During Providence, the user heals for 30% of the damage dealt, and the skill inflicts the Blind status for 5 seconds (100% chance).
This skill is affected by Spear Flurry. Requires a Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Performs a holy rite, bestowing a divine benediction on the party that massively improves their offense and defense. Grants all party members improved Defense Pierce, Magic Defense Pierce, Defense, and Magic Defense for 30 seconds. The duration of this skill is increased by 3 seconds per level of the user's Divine Grace.

This skill is learned at level 1; its effective level is raised through the Grace and Authority system, up to a maximum of 15. Grants 3% Defense Pierce and Magic Defense Pierce, 5 Defense, and 2.5 Magic Defense per effective level.
Costs 500 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds. Has a cast time of 5s FCT.
Benedictio Sanctissimi Sacramenti.requires: Coluceo Heal Lv10, Gloria Lv10, Magnificat Lv10

desc: The user enters a battle rage for 10 seconds, massively increasing their combat abilities at the expense of rational thought. The user gains 50% damage reduction and +50 ASPD for the duration, but cannot use any skills or consumables. Triggering this skill also activates Meltdown and Whirling Axe at half the level learned for the full duration, sets the user's Max ASPD to 190, and heals them to full. When the Berserk status ends, the user loses all SP and their HP is set to 10% of Maximum.
Costs 100 SP at all levels.
Deals a large amount of Fire property Magical damage in a 7x7 area around the caster with a chance to inflict the Burning status.
When cast, takes the level of Advanced Ninjutsu Mastery instead of it's own level for determining damage, with an additional bonus that scales with the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art Status. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, Second Art ends, and Departing Shadow has it's cooldown reset.
Has an SP cost of 40 and a cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
All Advanced Ninja Arts share a cooldown.

Performs a lengthy ritual to call on the spirits of nature, summoning a vicious heatwave to the user's location. For 10 minutes across a 31x31 area, all Fire damage is increased and all Earth damage is decreased, and the Crit Rate of all creatures is increased by 3 per level of Ritual Mastery. Casting this skill disables all other Nature Rituals for 60 seconds; only one Nature Ritual can be active at a time. Has a base cast time of 10s FCT, reduced by Ritual Mastery.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
The user unleashes a burst of roaring flame, dealing Fire Property Damage to all enemies in the chosen direction.
* First Art: this skill's Fixed Cast Time is removed. * Second Art: this skill's Variable Cast Time is removed. * Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Blazing Dragon at Level 5.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Matk per point of Str and Dex. Affects a 5x9 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.

Fires a specialized shell that explodes in a cloud of burning shrapnel, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies in a 7x7 area and attempting to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds. Enemies that are already Bleeding are inflicted with the Slow status instead. This skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Vulnerable enemies.
This skill is refreshed by Rapid Reload if you have a Shotgun equipped. Requires a Shotgun.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Blesses an ally, shifting fate slightly in their favor. Increases Hit, Flee, and Perfect Dodge for a set duration.

The user dashes to a distant target up to 9 cells away, hitting them with a surprise attack that has a chance to inflict the Blind status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Commands the Falcon to attack the target, dealing Neutral property damage that ignores Defense to them and all enemies in the area. All affected enemies have a chance of being Slowed, which is increased if the target is suffering from any of the Bleeding, Burning, or Poison statuses. This skill has a chance to be autocast when making non-skill attacks with a Bow, ignoring all cooldowns but dealing half damage; the autocast chance is increased by 1% per 5 points of LUK. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Agility. Requires a Falcon. Has a cast time of 0.2s FCT + 0.8s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user draws a cursed mark on the target, inflaming their Bleeding status. If the target is not suffering from Bleeding, inflicts the status for 5 seconds. If they are, the mark ignites, dealing Bleeding damage every second to all enemies in a 7x7 area around the target, including the target themselves. If Chaser's Instinct is active, each time the mark inflicts damage it has a chance to inflict the Bleeding status. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Invokes the power of the Thurisaz Rune, the rune of Thorns. For the duration, all autoattacks from the user are treated as Bleeding Damage and have a chance of 1% per level of Rune Research to autocast Rend at the learned level. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Increases the attack range and Hit rate of Bow class weapons.
The bonus range granted by Bow Mastery does NOT affect skills.

Swings the spear wildly in front of the user, dealing heavy damage. Any Vulnerable targets take additional damage and have their Vulnerable duration refreshed to 10 seconds. Requires a Spear or Two-Handed Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user brings the moon to its lowest, heralding the coming of dawn. Releases a burst of celestial energy to strike all enemies in a 7x7 area, dealing Physical damage with additional damage equal to 1% Atk per point of Agi and Vit, and refreshing the cooldowns of Moonrise, Dead of Night, and itself. When cast, this skill advances the user's Celestial State by one towards Nightfall (state duration 10 seconds).

* No Celestial State: this skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Blind enemies. * Rising Moon: this skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Vulnerable enemies. * Midnight: this skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Blind and Vulnerable enemies, and the cooldown refresh ability of the skill is disabled.
This skill will fail if the user's Celestial State is in Daylight.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

Fires a rending shot at an enemy aimed at piercing their defenses and damaging their armor. Has a high change of inflicting the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. This skill deals +25% final damage to enemies suffering from each of the Bleeding or Slow statues.
Fixed cast time of 0.5s and a cooldown of 8 seconds at all levels.

The user jumps out from hiding, striking all enemies in a 7x7 area around them. For 2 seconds after this skill is cast, the user can cast Ambush as if they were in Hiding. Requires the Hiding or Cloaking state. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user calls down the wrath of the noonday sun to scorch their opponents, dealing Physical damage to a single target.

* No Celestial State: this skill enhances the Burning effect on the target. * Rising Sun: this skill enhances the Internal Bleeding effect on the target. * High Noon: this skill's damage is treated as half Burning damage and half Bleeding damage.
This skill will fail if the user's Celestial State is in Nightfall.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Infuses the user's weapon with a flash of holy light, dealing damage according to the element of the equipped weapon and attempting to inflict the Blind status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Dexterity. Requires a Spear or Two-Handed Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 6 seconds at all levels.

The user focuses all of their efforts on defense, enabling them to dodge attacks with superhuman reflexes. Massively increases the user's Perfect Dodge for 5 seconds, but reduces the user's Movement Speed. Does not stack with Gunslinger's Gambit.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Invokes the power of the Eihwaz Rune, the rune of the Yew, to unleash a burst of flame enveloping a 9x9 area at the targeted location. Deals Physical Fire property damage with a chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds (50% chance, plus 5% per level of Rune Research). Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Int. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user burns with conviction, preparing themselves for feats of great physical prowess. Passively increases the amount of damage inflicted by Sura skills against targets that have any number of Stigmata stacks.

When activated, grants the user the Burning Faith status, during which Raging Trifecta Blow, Raging Quadruple Blow, and Raging Thrust each inflict one stack of Stigmata and are treated as Sura skills for Stigmata's damage boosting effect. The active effect does not stack with Indomitable Faith.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.

Invokes the power of the Hagalaz Rune, the rune of Wrath. For 10 seconds (plus 0.5 seconds per level of Rune Research), all Physical skills cast by the user deal additional damage based on their bonuses to Burning Damage. This skill does not affect Ignition Break. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user fires a quick three round burst, dealing exceptional Physical Damage and inflicting the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. If the target is already Vulnerable, it inflicts the Slow status instead. This skill deals 30% additional Final Damage against Bleeding enemies.
This skill is refreshed by Rapid Reload if you have a Rifle equipped. Requires a Rifle.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT.

The user turns their defensive barrier into offensive power, delivering a devastating blow to a single target. Deals 50% additional final damage if the user has a Barrier active, and 50% additional final damage against Vulnerable enemies. Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Vitality.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Burst Slash.requires: Shield Press Lv5, Shield Shooting Lv5

desc: The user marks a target for death, applying the Called Shot status to a single enemy for 10 seconds: while active, the user deals more damage to and takes less damage from that enemy, but all attacks against enemies they did not mark will miss. If the user had three Preparation Counters when this skill was cast, it also inflicts the Vulnerable status for the duration; otherwise, they immediately gain Preparation Counters. This skill ends early if the target dies. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user launches their spear with the strength of a cannon, driving it through all enemies in a straight line before them. Deals 30% additional final damage per status against targets that are Bleeding, Blind, or Vulnerable; any target suffering from at least two of those statuses is additionally Stunned for 2 seconds. Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Dexterity. Requires a Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user infuses their weapon with divine might for 5 minutes, granting them unparalleled ability to smite the wicked. Enchants the user's weapon with the Holy property, increases their Hit Rate, and grants all Paladin skills enhanced effects. Does not stack with Providence. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
The user infuses the energy of the sky into their hands and feet, inflicting a single devastating blow on the targeted enemy. This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Atk per point of Luk.
This skill can only be used in a Nightfall Celestial State, or in the Celestial Miracle state.

* Nightfall: ends the user's current Celestial State, then refreshes the cooldowns of Moonrise, Dead of Night, and Breaking Dawn. * Celestial Miracle: the SP cost is removed and Cosmic Union's autocast chain returns to Sunrise.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT.

The user calls down the wrath of the sky, raining destruction across a wide 11x11 area. Enemies within the area take repeated damage every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds. This skill deals additional damage equal to 3% Atk per point of Luk.
This skill can only be used in a Daylight Celestial State, or the Celestial Miracle state.

* Daylight: ends the user's current Celestial State, then refreshes the cooldowns of Sunrise, Brilliant Noon, and Duskfall. * Celestial Miracle: the skill's SP Cost is removed and the autocast chain for Cosmic Union is returned to Sunrise.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
The user enters a state of perfect harmony with the celestial lights, charging their attacks with incredible strength for 60 seconds. Blocks the user from shifting their Celestial State.
While this skill is active, all Sky Emperor skills deal reduced damage based on the user's Remaining SP, at 1% per 1% Remaining SP.

If Cosmic Union is active, its autocasts are replaced with Sky Emperor skills, which cast in the following order: Sunrise > Brilliant Noon > Duskfall > Moonrise > Dead of Night > Breaking Dawn. The skills will be cast at the same level as this skill. Once Breaking Dawn is cast, Cosmic Union returns to its original behavior.
Costs 100% of the user's current SP.

The user fires a multi-stage explosive which detonates three times in quick succession, hitting progressively wider areas each time (5x5 / 7x7 / 9x9). The damage dealt by this skill is treated as Burning Damage. Any target struck has a chance of receiving the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds; this chance is doubled against enemies that have the Crimson Marker status.
Requires 1 Grenade and a Grenade Launcher equipped in the sub-weapon slot.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s VCT.

Invokes a burst of lightning on a single target, dealing Wind property Magic damage before bouncing to another enemy within an 11x11 range; if no other enemies are in range, the same target can be struck multiple times. Deals 30% additional final damage to enemies that are Sleeping or Dazed. If the user is in Wind Affinity, the skill gains 3 additional bounces and the Wind Affinity status is refreshed. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point of Agi. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user hones and sharpens their instincts, maximizing their ability to debilitate and disable enemies. While active, Intimidate, Debilitate, Disorient, and Ambush inflict their statuses at a 100% chance regardless of skill level, and all Shadow Chaser skills inflict additional status effects. This skill stacks with other Instincts.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.

The user refreshes themselves, removing the Bleeding, Burning, and Poison statuses from themselves and restoring a small amount of HP for each status removed. If Chaser's Instinct is active, this skill also inflicts Blind, Slow, or Vulnerable (one chosen at random, 100% chance, 5 seconds) on all enemies in a 5x5 area around the user.
Costs 25 SP with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
Improves the effectiveness of Chemical-type skills, including Acid Terror, Demonstration, and Conflagration, and increases the likelihood these skills will successfully inflict their status effects.

The user creates a blast of supernaturally cold air, dealing minor Water property damage and inflicting the Chilled status for 5 seconds on all enemies in a 9x9 area. Enemies that are already Chilled take 30% increased damage and have a small chance to be Frozen for 10 seconds. Damage is increased by 0.5% MATK per point of Vitality. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
The user delivers a piercing strike, spinning the spear to enhance its penetrative power. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Dexterity and by the user's Vulnerable Potency.
* If the user is in Vanguard Stance, the cooldown is halved. * If the user is in Warden Stance, the target takes additional damage equal to the user's current HP, to a maximum of 30,000.
Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of the stat granted by the active Stance. Requires a One or Two-Handed Spear. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Delivers a sundering blow to a single target, cleaving through most defensive abilities. Removes most defensive statuses from the target, then deals damage with 30% additional final damage if the target is Vulnerable. If the target is not Vulnerable, this skill has a high chance to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% per point of Vitality.
Has a base cooldown of 8 seconds at all levels.

The user surrounds themselves with a cloak of mystical fire that lashes out to burn any enemies that approach. Deals a small amount of Fire property damage every second to all enemies in a 5x5 area around the caster, inflicting them with the Fire Vulnerability status (30% strength, 10 second duration). Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point of Luck. Lasts 5 minutes.
Costs 20 SP to cast, plus 2 SP per hit dealt.

The user fades into the darkness, making themselves undetectable and untargetable by enemies and boosting their movement speed for 5 seconds. This skill does not evade ground-targeted skills or skills that targeted the user before Cloaking was cast.
Costs 15 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.
Summons bolts of ice to rain down on a distant target, dealing Water property damage. The damage is increased if the target is Chilled.

The user casts a wide ranging blessing, mending the wounds of all party members simultaneously. Immediately heals all party members in a 31x31 area for an amount equal to a Heal skill of the same level.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds, reduced by 2 seconds per level of Divine Grace. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 2s VCT.
Orders the Homunculus to perform its Attack action, ignoring the usual cooldown. A Homunculus can only receive this Command once every 30 seconds.
Orders the Homunculus to perform its Defense action, ignoring the usual cooldown. A Homunculus can only receive this Command once every 30 seconds.
Orders the Homunculus to perform its Hide action, ignoring the usual cooldown. A Homunculus can only receive this Command once every 10 seconds.
Orders the Homunculus to move to the targeted location.
Orders the Homunculus to teleport back to its master's side.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds.
Orders the Homunculus to perform its Support action, ignoring the usual cooldown. A Homunculus can only receive this Command once every 30 seconds.
Orders the Homunculus to perform its Ultimate action, ignoring the usual cooldown. A Homunculus can only receive this Command once every 30 seconds.

Tosses a concoction of volatile chemicals at an enemy which explodes on contact, consuming all of the user's Extort stacks to deal Neutral property damage to them and all other enemies in the area. Each stack consumed adds one additional hit. Has a chance to inflict the Bleeding and Burning statuses on all enemies affected, increased by an additional 3% per level of Chemical Research. Damage is increased by 0.5% ATK per point of Intelligence.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

The user harmonizes themselves with the cosmos, drawing closer to the heavenly bodies and further away from their mundane roots. They gain the ability to divine greater truths from seemingly mundane knowledge, able to transform raw intellect into physical strength in a way more direct than even magic. Increases the damage and Hit Rate of Book class weapons, as well as passively increasing the user's Luk.

The user channels the power of the unified cosmos, unleashing it in a massive blast of pure energy in a 9x9 area around themselves. Deals Physical damage that is greatly increased by the user's Luk, at 5% Atk per point of Luk. * Solar Heat: the damage is treated as Burning Damage, but bonuses to Burning Damage are significantly reduced (33% of the bonus is applied). * Lunar Protection: the attack gains 10% Life Steal. * Stellar Blessing: the attack ignores the target's Defense. * Umbral Veil: the attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate. * Cosmic Union: the cooldown of Cosmic Revelation is reset.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the unified cosmos, giving them an enormous bonus to all stats for 10 seconds. While active, the SP Cost of all Star Emperor skills is reduced to 0, and the internal cooldown of Cosmic Union autocasts is ignored. This effect lasts for 10 seconds, or until a certain number of skills have been cast (autocasted skills do not count for this limit).
The number of charges is 1 + (Skill Level / 3)
Costs 0 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user unifies with the balanced forces of the cosmos, channeling the power of the Sun, the Moon, the Stars, and the darkness between them simultaneously. This skill is a toggle. While active, the following effects apply:

* Movement Speed is increased based on Cosmic Union level. * Attack is increased by 2% per Solar Heat level. * Max HP is increased by 2% per Lunar Protection level. * Defense Pierce is increased by 2% per Stellar Blessing level. * Crit Rate is increased by 2 per Umbral Veil level. * All attacks have a chance to autocast Star Gladiator skills at Level 1, with a 1 second autocast cooldown. * Star Gladiator skills gain Luk scaling of 2% ATK per point of Luk. * Star Gladiator skills gain their Alignment bonuses. * Max SP is reduced to 1.
Does not stack with other Cosmic Alignments.
Costs 100 SP, with a cooldown of 3 minutes after toggling off.
Delivers a powerful kick to the enemy, ignoring the target's Flee and bypassing skills like Guard and Deflect.

Using this skill grants the Counter Stance for 5 seconds, during which time all kicks ignore Flee and all attacks bypass Guard. Counter stance ends when any other Stance ends or when Counter Kick is cast again.
Has a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Counter Kick.requires: Martial Endurance Lv3, Martial Discipline Lv3

desc: The user lashes out with perfect timing, dealing Melee Physical damage in a 7x7 area around themselves, with 30% additional final damage against Vulnerable enemies. If the user is in the Counter State, the skill repeats again at half damage.

* Toxic Blades: the damage is treated as Poison damage. * Flashing Blades: the damage is treated as Bleeding damage. * Rejuvenating Blades: the user gains the Hallucination Walk effect for 3 seconds. * Peerless Blades: subtracts 5 seconds from the active cooldown of Weapon Blocking.
Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Dagger.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Whips the user's party into an uproar, consuming the user's Extortion stacks to boost all nearby members' Crit Rate by 3 per stack, and Attack Speed by 1 per stack.
25 SP cost at all levels. 30s Cooldown at all levels.

Fires a blazing arrow at the target, dealing Fire property Magic damage to them and all targets in a straight line. Any enemy struck that is Burning takes 30% additional final damage; otherwise, the skill has a chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds. If the user is in Fire Affinity, the damage is treated as Burning Damage and the duration of Fire Affinity is refreshed. Damage is increased by 3% MATK per point of Luk. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Passively increases the duration of the Crimson Marker status inflicted by the user, from a base duration of 5 seconds. Crimson Marker enhances the effects of all Night Watch skills that target that enemy.

Calls down a flaming meteor to destroy the targeted enemy, dealing Fire property damage in a 9x9 area and attempting to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds on them and all other enemies in the area. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 2s VCT, plus an additional 0.15s FCT + 0.5s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
Leaps to a distant enemy up to 7 cells away and delivers a series of lethal blows with a pair of equipped daggers. This skill gains additional effects based on the active Blade Enchant:

* Rejuvenating Blades: Gain the Cloaking status for 2 seconds. * Toxic Blades: Inflicts the Deadly Poison status for 2 seconds per level of Toxic Blades. * Flashing Blades: Cooldown reduced by 5 seconds.
Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Dagger.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Delivers a crushing blow to the enemy, dealing high damage that can Crit and has a chance to Stun for 2 seconds.
If the target is already stunned, deals 50% additional damage and has 50 bonus Crit Rate.
Requires an Axe.

Invokes the power of the Raidho Rune, the rune of Decisiveness, to deliver a crushing blow to a single target. Inflicts the Vulnerable status (100% chance) for an extended duration of 1 second per level of Rune Research. If the target is already Vulnerable, also inflicts the Stun status for 2 seconds. Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Int and by the user's Vulnerable Potency. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The caster unleashes a devastating wave of sound, inflicting Magic damage to all enemies in a 9x9 area, hitting twice per Rhythm level, which is consumed. Damage is increased by 0.5% MATK per point of Luck. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user deals a massive blow to the targeted enemy, inflicting heavy damage to them and all enemies in a 7x7 area around them. This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% per point of Int and Dex.

* Second Art or Third Art: this attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate. * Both: the attack is guaranteed to Crit, both Arts end, and all targets struck are Stunned at a 100% chance for 2 seconds. * First Art only: Flashing Steel, Soaring Steel, Fulminant Steel, and Ravenous Steel have their cooldowns refreshed, and the duration of First Art is refreshed.
Each level of this skill learned passively increases the damage of Flashing Steel and Soaring Steel.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Crushing Steel.requires: Fulminant Steel Lv3, Ravenous Steel Lv3

desc: The user sings a mysterious note, bestowing strength on their allies from beyond their understanding. All allies within range under the effect of Hypnotic Harmony receive, per Rhythm level consumed: +1 Intelligence and Dexterity, +10% Magic Defense Pierce, −10% Variable Cast Time, and −0.1s Fixed Cast Time, then have the duration of their Hypnotic Harmony refreshed. Does not stack with Woeful Warcry or Eternal Echo. Casting this skill consumes the user's Rhythm level. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Administers a drug that clears the target's mind, massively increasing their Hit Rate and reducing their Fixed Cast Times, but also reducing their Defense and Magic Defense (side effects reduced by Stimulant Research). If cast at level 3 or higher, also generates one Extort and makes the target's casting uninterruptible for the duration. This skill's duration is 15 seconds per Extort stack the user has, but the stacks are not consumed. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 40 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on the spirits of nature to attack the targeted enemy, draining them of strength and weakening their defenses. Deals Ghost Property Magic Damage to a single target, attempting to inflict the Breach status for 5 seconds. The damage of this skill is heavily influenced by the user's remaining AP, modified by -5% Final Damage per 10 AP above or below 100.
* AP within 50 of 100: deals 30% additional Final Damage to Breached enemies. * AP within 10 of 100: the user is healed for a portion of the damage dealt.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Curse of Absorption.requires: Ritual of Invocation Lv1, Ritual of Binding Lv1

desc: The user opens a gate to the spiritual realm, allowing a torrent of spirits to inundate the area and wash away all opposition. Deals massive Ghost Property Physical Damage to all enemies in a 21x21 area around the user. The damage of this skill is heavily influenced by the user's remaining AP, modified by -5% Final Damage per 10 AP above or below 100.
* AP within 50 of 100: also inflicts the Blind status at a 100% chance for 5 seconds. * AP within 10 of 100: inflicts the Stun status instead, for 2 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.

The user calls on the spirits of nature to attack the target, blinding and distracting them. Deals Ghost Property Physical Damage and attempts to inflict the Blind status for 5 seconds. The damage of this skill is heavily influenced by the user's remaining AP, modified by -5% Final Damage per 10 AP above or below 100.
* AP within 50 of 100: deals 30% additional Final Damage to Blind enemies. * AP within 10 of 100: also grants the user a 25% boost to Movement Speed for 5 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

The user calls on the spirits of nature to attack the target's physical body and armor, dealing Ghost Property Physical Damage and attempting to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. The damage of this skill is heavily influenced by the user's remaining AP, modified by -5% Final Damage per 10 AP above or below 100.
* AP within 50 of 100: deals 30% additional Final Damage to Vulnerable enemies. * AP within 10 of 100: grants the user a Barrier with HP based on a portion of the damage dealt.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Curse of Destruction.requires: Ritual of Invocation Lv1, Ritual of Binding Lv1

desc: The user calls on the spirits of nature to attack the enemy's soul directly, dealing Ghost Property Magic Damage over time for 5 seconds. The damage of this skill is heavily influenced by the user's remaining AP, modified by -5% Final Damage per 10 AP above or below 100. The damage is fixed at the time of casting.
* AP within 50 of 100: also inflicts the Slow status at a 100% chance for 5 seconds. * AP within 10 of 100: the duration of both statuses is doubled.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

The user calls on the spirits of nature to bind and suppress all enemies around them, dealing massive Ghost Property Magic Damage in a 21x21 area. The damage of this skill is heavily influenced by the user's remaining AP, modified by -5% Final Damage per 10 AP above or below 100.
* AP within 50 of 100: also inflicts the Slow status at a 100% chance for 5 seconds. * AP within 10 of 100: inflicts the Sleep status instead.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.
Increases the damage, Double Attack chance, and Hit rate when wielding a dagger.
Increases the damage and Hit Rate of Whips, and increases the duration of Rhythm levels gained by the user. This skill is exclusive to Dancers.
The user delivers a rending blow with their katar, seeking out weaknesses in the enemy's armor through which to inflict maximum damage.

* Toxic Blades: additionally inflicts the Poison status. * Flashing Blades: additionally inflicts the Bleeding status. * Rejuvenating Blades: additionally inflicts the Blind status. * Peerless Blades: extends the duration of Sonic Acceleration by 2 seconds if it is active.
Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Katar.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Plays a haunting melody that clouds the minds of all enemies that hear it, inflicting the Blind status on all enemies that approach the user for 10 seconds. The strength of the Blind is increased by 1 Potency per 5 points of the user's Luk. If Rhythm level is Odd, it increases by 1; if Even, it decreases by 1. This skill is exclusive to Bards. Requires an Instrument. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user delivers a whirling kick, scattering enemies with the power of the moon. Deals Physical damage to all enemies in a 7x7 area around the user, with additional damage equal to 1% Atk per point of Agi and Vit.

* No Celestial State: refreshes the duration of Blind on all targets struck to 5 seconds. * Rising Moon: refreshes the duration of Vulnerable on all targets struck to 5 seconds. * Midnight: deals increased damage based on half of the user's bonuses to Blind and Vulnerable Potency.
This skill will fail if the user's Celestial State is in Daylight.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

The user dashes toward a distant target up to 9 cells away, inflicting a small amount of damage and leaving behind a Mirage at their original location. If the user has no Ninja Arts active, they also gain the First Art status. Up to three Mirages can be active at a given time.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% Atk per point of Int and Dex.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user turns invisible for a short time, making them undetectable. The next attack the user makes gains a bonus to Defense Pierce and Crit Damage.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Infuses the ground with necrotic energy, creating a 9x9 zone of desecrated land that deals Undead property damage over time to all enemies inside. The attack gains 2% life steal for each Void Sphere the user has. If Void Infusion: Undead is active, this skill's cooldown is halved. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point each of Agility and Vitality. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

Injects the target with a deadly neurotoxin, dealing an instant burst of Physical Poison property damage that is treated as Poison Status damage and always inflicts Poison for 5 seconds. Deals 3% additional final damage per level of Stimulant Research, and is increased by 2% ATK per point of Intelligence. If cast at level 3 or higher, also generates one Extort and inflicts the Deadly Poison status. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 40 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user channels necrotic energies to sap the life of the targeted enemy, dealing Undead property Magic damage to a single target, then healing the user for a fixed amount of 50/150/250/300 per level depending on how low the target's HP is. Each cast has a chance to summon a Void Sphere; if Void Infusion: Undead is active, that chance is doubled. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point each of Agility and Vitality. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Deals a swift blow inflicting minor damage, but also attempting to inflict the Blind, Slow, and Vulnerable statuses. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Luck.
Has a base cooldown of 6 seconds at all levels.

Issues a command to all active drones in a 31x31 area to shift into a protective mode. Nearby Drones enter a Defensive state, gaining new skills for 5 seconds, while the user and their allies gain a small Barrier, increased by 10% per level of Drone Construction. Costs 3 Extort stacks (waived while no Madogear is active). Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
Blocks all physical attacks received for 3 seconds. Requires a Two-Handed Sword or Spear.
Costs 20 SP at all levels.
The user delivers a quick, distracting jab to the enemy, taking advantage of any gaps in their defense:
* If the target is Blind, inflicts the Vulnerable status. * If the target is Vulnerable, inflicts the Bleeding status. * If the target is Bleeding, inflicts the Blind status.
Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Summons a torrent of raging water to inundate the targeted 7x7 location, inflicting Water property damage over time to all enemies within. Enemies suffering from the Chilled status take 20% increased damage. Damage is increased by 0.5% MATK per point of Vitality. Only one Land Spell can be active at a time. Has a cast time of 0.2s FCT + 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

The user unleashes a kick with tremendous force, dealing exceptional damage based on the number of currently active Stances. All Stances immediately end after casting this skill. This skill has no effect if there are no currently active stances. Requires Taekwon Mission to be learned.
Has a cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

Hurls a bottle of flammable liquid to the target location, which ignites on contact and burns for 5 seconds. Any enemies in the area take Fire property damage and have a chance to start Burning. The Burn chance is increased by an additional 1% per level of Chemical Research. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Intelligence. Generates one stack of Extort when cast.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Throws the currently equipped Offhand weapon at the target while backsliding 5 cells to safety.
The damage of this skill is heavily influenced by the user's STR and INT.

Casting this skill grants the Second Art status. If the First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has a 50% chance to inflict Slow. If both are active, the chance is instead 100%, First Art ends, and Soaring Steel has it's cooldown reset.
SP cost of 15 and cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels. 9 cell range.

Deploys a mobile Combat Drone to fight alongside the user for 15 seconds, plus 2 seconds per level of Drone Construction. Combat Drones are melee combatants that constantly inflict Severe Burning with their attacks. While alive, the Combat Drone passively grants its owner a bonus to their Maximum ASPD. Only one Combat Drone may be deployed at a time, but it can be deployed alongside other Drones. Costs 3 Extort stacks (waived while no Madogear is active). Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Deploys a mobile Support Drone to fight alongside the user for 15 seconds, plus 2 seconds per level of Drone Construction. Support Drones are ranged combatants that constantly inflict the Blind status on enemies with their attacks. While alive, the Support Drone grants its owner a bonus to their Defense Pierce. Only one Support Drone can be deployed at a time, but it can be deployed alongside other Drones. Costs 3 Extort stacks (waived while no Madogear is active). Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

The user adds a powerful chord to their performance, preparing for a desperate grand climax. Immediately applies the Melodic Mark status to all enemies and the Hypnotic Harmony status to all allies within range, for 10 seconds. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.
Desperate Dynamic.requires: Melodic Mark Lv5, Hypnotic Harmony Lv5

desc: Hammers the target with incredible force, dealing two hits of heavy damage to them and all nearby enemies. Any Bleeding enemies struck take one additional hit and have their Bleeding duration refreshed to 5 seconds. Requires a Sword or Two-Handed Sword.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user infuses their voice with destructive power and screams, dealing tremendous Hybrid damage in a 13x13 area and attempting to inflict Stun for 2 seconds on all enemies within. Deals 1 additional hit per Rhythm level above 1, and the Stun chance is 20% per Rhythm level; the user's Rhythm level then resets to zero. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
Devastating Descant.requires: Bard: Enervating Elegy Lv5, Darkening Dirge Lv5 / Dancer: Wearying Waltz Lv5, Sinister Saunter Lv5

desc: The user fires a distracting shot with their guns, creating an opening to remove themselves from a dangerous situation. Deals moderate physical damage to a single target, attempting to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds, then immediately backslides. If the target is already Slowed, inflicts Internal Bleeding instead. This skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to enemies that are Vulnerable.
This skill is refreshed by Rapid Reload if you have a Revolver equipped. Requires a Revolver.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Delivers a swift blow to the target before quickly vanishing, attempting to disorient and confuse them. Has a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status, which is doubled if the target is already Blind. The invisibility triggered by this skill counts as Cloaking (lasting 2 seconds), not Hiding. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Dexterity.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user's faith is rewarded, causing the holy power they call forth to smite foes to be empowered. Increases the effectiveness of all Authority skills. Whenever a Priest casts an Authority skill, they receive the Authority status; while under this status, the next Grace skill they cast will be cast at the same level as the skill which triggered the Authority status, assuming it is higher.

The user's faith is rewarded, causing the miracles they call forth to be empowered. Increases the effectiveness of all Grace skills cast by the user. Whenever a Priest casts a Grace skill, they receive the Grace status; while under this status, the next Authority skill they cast will be cast at the same level as the skill which triggered the Grace status, assuming it is higher.

Calls a divine curse down on the target, marking their impending doom. Doubles the damage of any attack that hits the target; the effect ends after the target takes a certain number of hits. The cooldown is 60 seconds, reduced by 3 seconds per level of Divine Authority. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 250 SP at all levels.
Divine Judgment.requires: Banishing Light Lv3, Searing Light Lv3, Purifying Light Lv3

desc: The user conjures a tremendously powerful evil spirit to deal massive Ghost Property Damage to all enemies in a 9x9 area around them. Enemies suffering from Vulnerable and Blind take 20% additional Final Damage per status. Casting this skill generates 6 Spirits.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.

The user conjures a torrent of evil spirits to wreak havoc across the battlefield, dealing Ghost Property Magic Damage in a huge 15x15 area around them. This skill deals 20% additional Final Damage per status to Breached and Slowed enemies. Casting this skill generates 6 Spirits.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.
Fires two arrows in quick succession, dealing moderate damage. This skill gains 50 bonus Crit rate against Slowed targets.
3 second cooldown at all levels.
The user throws an explosive projectile at the target which immediately detonates, dealing massive damage to all enemies in a 7x7 area. The damage deals an additional 5% Atk per point of Str and Int.

* First Art or Third Art: this skill inflicts Vulnerable and Breach at a 100% chance for 5 seconds. * Both: it additionally inflicts Stun, both Arts end, and Shifting Shadow's duration is extended by 1 second per target. * Second Art only: refreshes the cooldowns of Echoing Shadow, Departing Shadow, Whirling Shadow, and Fluttering Shadow.
Requires a Shuriken, Kunai, or Huuma.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Dragon's Shadow.requires: Whirling Shadow Lv3, Fluttering Shadow Lv3

desc: Backslides and hides after a short cast, leaving behind a decoy that explodes for a minimal amount of damage after a short delay. The Hiding triggered lasts 1.5 seconds. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT.
Costs 25 SP at all levels.

Skill in the construction and handling of Drones, semi-autonomous robots that fight alongside the user. Each level increases the stats of summoned Drones and enhances the effects of supporting Protocol skills. While a Madogear is not active, the Extort cost of all Drone skills is ignored. Drones inherit their summoner's Str, Int, Vit, Agi, Hit, and half of their Crit. Monsters will not target Drones with attacks. [[File:SupportDronegif.gif|alt=ranged Aoe damage, blind support and health regen.|thumb|Support drone. ]] [[File:AttackDrone.gif.gif|thumb|Combat drone.]]

Restores the damage and a portion of the ASPD lost from dual wielding daggers. The dual wielding penalty is only applied to normal attacks, not skills. Weapon Masteries of offhand weapons are not applied unless specifically stated.

The user calls on the power of the setting sun to scorch their opponents. Deals a large amount of Physical damage, with additional damage equal to 1% Atk per point of Int and Dex, then refreshes the cooldowns of Sunrise, Brilliant Noon, and itself, then advances the user's Celestial State by one towards Daylight (state duration 10 seconds).

* No Celestial State: this skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Burning enemies. * Rising Sun: this skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Bleeding enemies. * High Noon: this skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Burning and Bleeding enemies, and its cooldown refreshing effect is disabled.
This skill will fail if the user's Celestial State is in Nightfall.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

Causes a stone lance to erupt from the ground beneath the target, inflicting Earth property damage. Deals 30% additional damage to enemies suffering from the Bleeding status. Damage is increased by 0.2% MATK per point of Dexterity. Has a cast time of 0.1s FCT plus 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.
Copies the effect of the skill granted by the currently equipped offhand weapon. The copied skill is cast at this skill's level instead of the weapon's skill level.
Cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

The user unleashes a massive blast of elemental energy, obliterating a single target and all enemies in a 7x7 area around them. The targets take damage in four waves, in the order of Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth; each wave gains the stat scaling that matches its element (5% MATK per point of the matching stat). If the user is currently under any Elemental Affinity, all four waves match that element instead. Has a cast time of 4s FCT + 4s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.
Elemental Annihilation.requires: Frozen Grip Lv5, Chain Lightning Lv5, Stone Crush Lv5, Crimson Arrow Lv5

desc: Through study and research, the user attunes themselves to the natural forces that make up the world, making them easier to wield and defend against. Improves the damage of all Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth property magic of the user, while improving their resistance against the same.

Delivers a swift and deadly blow to the target, inflicting heavy damage that is amplified by 20% final damage for each negative status effect they are suffering from. Statuses checked: Bleeding, Burning, Poison, Blind, Slow, Vulnerable, Confusion, Chilled, Sleep, and Stun. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Luck, and deals bonus damage based on the user's bonuses to Bleeding, Burning, and Poison damage.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on the cosmic darkness of the universe, drowning out the light of the celestial bodies. Immediately ends the user's current Celestial State, then grants the Encroaching Darkness state for 5 seconds. During this state, all attacks against the user miss, but they cannot shift their Celestial State, and the abilities of Duskfall and Breaking Dawn to refresh skill cooldowns are disabled.
Costs 50% of the user's current HP.

Endows the target's armor with elemental magic for 5 minutes, reducing damage they take from that element by 10% per learned level, but increasing damage they take from its opposite by 10% per learned level. The potency of this skill is based on the max level learned, regardless of the level cast.

Casting this skill at Level 1 forces the target's armor to be Neutral property and prevents the target's armor property from changing for the duration. Each level above Level 1 requires an elemental catalyst crafted at the Sage Castle in Juno. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 50 SP at all levels.

Endows the target's weapon with elemental magic for 5 minutes, changing the property of their attacks and enhancing any magic they use of the corresponding element by 4% per learned level. The endowed element also grants the target's skills additional stat scaling of 0.5% MATK per point of the corresponding stat, and the skills Deluge, Whirlwind, and Inferno gain additional scaling based on which Endow is active. The potency of this skill is based on the max level learned, regardless of the level cast.

Casting this skill at Level 1 forces the target's weapon to be Neutral property and prevents the target's weapon property from changing for the duration, but does not improve the strength of Neutral property magic. Each level above Level 1 requires an elemental catalyst crafted at the Sage Castle in Juno. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 50 SP at all levels.
The user brafces themselves for incoming damage, allowing them to take hits without flinching and reducing incoming damage by 30% for a short duration.

Coats an ally's armor with an alchemical agent that disperses the force of incoming attacks, improving their resistance to attacks of all elements. Non-Neutral resistance is increased by 2% per level of Enhancement Research. When applied to a Homunculus, instead reduces all damage taken by the Homunculus by 1% per level, plus an additional 1% per level of Enhancement Research learned. Shift + Click to apply to Homunculi.
Costs 20 SP at all levels.

The user creates a magical barrier that reduces the damage of all incoming attacks for 5 minutes. The more SP the user has remaining, the more powerful the barrier: damage is reduced by 2% for each bracket of Max SP the user still has, but 1% of Max SP is drained every time damage is reduced by this skill. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.
Costs 50% of the user's current SP to cast.

Plays an eerie tune that saps the energy from all enemies that hear it, inflicting the Vulnerable and Breach statuses on all enemies that approach the user for 10 seconds. The strength of the status effects is improved by 1% Potency per 5 points of the user's Int. If Rhythm level is Even or zero, it increases by 1; if Odd, it decreases by 1. This skill is exclusive to Bards. Requires an Instrument. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Research into the use of Alchemical Enhancements. Improves the duration and effect of all Alchemical Enhancements.
Deals a minor amount of Poison element damage with a chance of inflicting the Poison status on the target.
3 second cooldown at all levels.

Creates an illusory tree of divine light, filling the targeted 11x11 area with holy energies that reject the caster's foes for the duration. While the tree persists, all enemies in the area take Holy Property damage and are inflicted with the Breach, Vulnerable, and Slow statuses every second, each lasting 5 seconds.
This skill is learned at level 1; its effective level is raised through the Grace and Authority system, up to a maximum of 15. This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% Matk per point of Luk.
Costs 500 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds. Has a cast time of 5s FCT.
Epiclesis.requires: Flamen Lv10, Oleum Sanctum Lv10, Magnus Exorcismus Lv10

desc: Improves the duration and effectiveness of Weapon Reinforcement and Armor Reinforcement.

Mastery in the creation of physical modifications to all kinds of equipment. Increases the effectiveness of Weapon and Armor Modifications for the user. Does not influence the result of Modification attempts, nor give any bonus to other players who use them.

Performs a lengthy ritual to call on the spirits of nature, hastening the natural decay of all things around the user's location. For 10 minutes across a 31x31 area, all Earth damage is increased and all Wind damage is decreased, and the Bleeding, Burning, and Poison damage taken by all creatures is increased by 3% per level of Ritual Mastery. Casting this skill disables all other Nature Rituals for 60 seconds; only one Nature Ritual can be active at a time. Has a base cast time of 10s FCT, reduced by Ritual Mastery.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user sings an echoing note, drawing supernatural persistence from the souls of their allies. All allies within a 25x25 area under the effect of Hypnotic Harmony receive, per Rhythm level consumed: +1 Agility and Luck, +0.4 Max ASPD, and 5% Cooldown Reduction, then have the duration of their Hypnotic Harmony refreshed. Does not stack with Woeful Warcry or Cryptic Cadence. Casting this skill consumes the user's Rhythm level. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Soul Reaper skills operate by manipulating evil spirits to exert their power on the material world. After using such skills, a Spirit remains in the air around the user. A Soul Reaper can hold up to ten Spirits at once, and they will persist for ten minutes or until consumed.
While a Soul Reaper bears any Spirits, all skills they cast cost an additional 1% Max HP for each Spirit they have.
This skill is for informational purposes only. It cannot be learned and has no effects.

Delivers a final, finishing blow to a single target, consuming their Bleeding to inflict a massive burst of damage. If the target is Bleeding, the Bleeding ends and they take additional base damage equal to (Bleed Tick × Skill Level / 20), capped at a Bleed Strength of 5,000. This skill does not interact with Internal Bleeding. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Luck.

* If the user is in Vanguard Stance, the cooldowns of Rend, Devastating Blow, and Quicken are refreshed. * If the user is in Warden Stance, additionally inflicts the Stun status for 2 seconds (100% chance).
Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of the stat granted by the active Stance. Requires a One or Two-Handed Sword.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

The user calls upon a blessing of war, preparing to mete out divine justice with their own hands. Increases the user's Attack and Vulnerable Potency for 5 minutes. The Attack gained is based on the level of the skill used, and the Vulnerable Potency is increased by 2% per level of the user's learned Divine Grace.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Fires a barrage of arrows strapped with explosives to obliterate the target and all enemies in a 9x9 area. All enemies struck are left Burning and Blind for 5 seconds (100% chance). Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point each of Agility and Vitality. For each Preparation Counter the user has, this skill's cast time is reduced by 1s FCT + 1s VCT and its damage is increased (10%/25%/50% final damage at 1/2/3 Counters); all Preparation Counters are then lost. This skill requires at least one Preparation Counter to cast. Has a base cast time of 5s FCT + 5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Explosive Barrage.requires: Hammer Shot Lv5, Razor Shot Lv5

desc: Causes explosive plant growth to overwhelm a 9x9 area: the plants rapidly grow, strike all enemies in the area, then immediately wither. Damage is increased by 0.5% ATK per point of Intelligence and by 3% per level of Flora Specialization; the status chance is increased by 1% per level of Flora Specialization.

* While the user's Wooden Warrior (Summon Warrior) is present, has a chance to inflict Vulnerable for 5 seconds. * While the user's Forest Sprite (Summon Fairy) is present, has a chance to inflict Blind for 5 seconds. * While the user's Cursed Tree (Summon Infernal Tree) is present, deals 50% additional total damage.
Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Delivers a blow to the target's financial future, inflicting moderate physical damage and gaining one stack of Extortion. 2 second cooldown.

The user creates a concealing wall of smoke, covering their tracks to make their escape. The user dashes to the targeted location and enters the Cloaking status for 3 seconds, leaving a Mirage at their original location. If the user has no Ninja Arts active, they also gain the Second Art status. Up to three Mirages can be active at a given time.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Increases the user's Max HP, and improves their Defense and Magic Defense while wearing a shield.
Enables renting of a Falcon from the Hunter's Guild and increases the damage of all Falcon related skills.
The user delivers a single crushing blow to the target, inflicting massive physical damage. This skill deals additional damage equal to 3% per point of Agi.
* Discipline: this skill is guaranteed to Crit and deals additional damage equal to 3% per point of Int. * Iron Fists: this skill's cooldown is halved.
This skill consumes the Discipline and Iron Fists statuses, but does not grant them.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT.
Falling Mountain.requires: Raging Barrage Lv3, Raging Windmill Lv3

desc: The user summons a blazing meteor to strike the targeted enemy, dealing Fire Property Magic Damage to all enemies around them.

* First Art or Second Art: the Fixed Cast Time of this skill is removed. * Both: the entire cast time is removed, both Arts end, and enemies struck receive the Severe Burning status at a 100% chance for 5 seconds. * Third Art only: enemies struck become vulnerable to Water Property attacks for 10 seconds, then all Basic and Advanced Ninja Arts have their cooldowns refreshed.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Matk per point of Str and Dex. Affects a 5x5 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.

Coats the user's weapon with a lethal toxin, enhancing the effects of the Poison and Deadly Poison statuses the user inflicts. Each level applies a different poison, which must be crafted; the poison's effectiveness is always based on the level of the skill learned, not the level cast. The enchant lasts until replaced. While any poison is active:

* All Assassin skills and Guillotine Cross Blade skills gain Luck scaling. * Grimtooth and Rolling Cutter increase the duration of Poison and Deadly Poison suffered by the target by 1 second. * Sonic Blow and Cross Impact deal additional damage based on the strength of the target's Poison status.
Does not stack with other Blade Enchants.
Costs 25 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user delivers a deadly slash to the target that leaves them exceptionally vulnerable to further damage. Applies the Death Mark status to the target for 5 seconds, causing all Physical attacks against them to be considered Critical Hits. This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Atk per point of Int and Dex.

* First Art and Second Art: all active Mirages immediately cast a random Basic Ninja Art at level 5 on the same target. * First Art and Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Echoing Shadow Level 5 on the same target. * Second Art and Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Prowling Steel at the same level.
This skill consumes all of the user's Ninja Arts, even if none of the above criteria are met.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user delivers a final devastating blow to the target, dealing massive damage with additional properties based on the target's remaining HP. If the target is above half HP, this skill inflicts the Blind and Vulnerable statuses for an extended 10-second duration (100% chance) and its cooldown is halved.
