If the target is below half HP, this skill deals 100% additional final damage. Damage is increased by 5% ATK per point of Dexterity.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Fate Sealer.requires: Deft Stab Lv5, Blindside Lv5, Breakout Lv5

desc: Specialization in the creation and modification of animal-based life. Each level increases the stats of summoned Homunculi, while also enhancing the effects of all Fauna skills.

Delivers a final, fatal blow to a single target, consuming their Poison and Deadly Poison to deal incredible damage, 50% additional final damage for each status consumed. If the target has neither status, the skill deals half damage.

* Toxic Blades: the target's Poison and Deadly Poison are refreshed instead of consumed. * Flashing Blades: this skill ignores the target's Defense. * Rejuvenating Blades: grants the user the Hallucination Walk status for 3 seconds. * Fatal Blades: this skill is guaranteed to be Critical against Poisoned enemies.
This skill gains Stat Scaling of 5% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Throws a ball of flame at an enemy, inflicting a small amount of Fire property damage to the target and all enemies in the area. Also has a high chance of inflicting the Burning status. The debuff duration is 5 seconds.
Hurls bolts of fire at a distant target, inflicting Fire property damage. Deals additional damage to targets suffering from the Burning status.

The user tosses a handful of explosive gunpowder around themselves, which ignites after a short delay and deals Physical Fire property damage to all enemies in a 7x7 area. All enemies struck are inflicted with the Burning status for 5 seconds (100% chance). For each Poisoned enemy struck, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1 second. The damage is treated as Burning Damage, and is increased by 2% ATK per point of Luck.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Creates a wall of intense flames that can hold back most enemies for 5 seconds. Enemies that make contact with the wall are knocked back, taking minimal Fire property damage and possibly receiving the Burning status for 5 seconds. Each cell of the wall can take 10 hits before breaking. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 45 SP at all levels.
Mastery with Revolvers, Rifles, and Shotguns. Increases the damage and accuracy of the above weapons.

Increases the damage, Attack Speed, and Hit Rate of Fist-type weapons; these bonuses also apply while the user is unarmed. Whenever the user casts a Combo skill, they gain the Iron Fists status for 10 seconds; while under this status, the next Spirit skill used will be cast at the same level as the skill that triggered this status, assuming it is higher.

Places a trap on the ground for 10 seconds that repeatedly unleashes bursts of burning gas every 0.5 seconds, damaging all enemies in a small area around it with a chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds. The trap's damage is treated as Ranged Physical, and is also treated as Burning Damage. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Summons a holy light to smite an enemy, dealing Holy Property Magic Damage to the target and all enemies around them. If the target is under the Searing Light status, the damage is increased by 30% Final Damage.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% Matk per point of Luk. Affects a 3x3 / 7x7 area. [fixme: the lub lists two areas with no stated condition or level breakdown]
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds, reduced by 1 second per level of Divine Authority. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 2s VCT.
Deals a modest amount of Fire property damage to a single target.
When cast, this skill takes the level of Magical Attunement instead of it's own level for determining damage, which also gains a bonus based on the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art satus. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, First Art Ends, and Flashing Steel has it's cooldown reset.
All Basic Ninja Arts share a Cooldown.
Has an SP cost of 25 and a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user unleashes a string of rapid combo skills, using Raging Trifecta Blow, Raging Quadruple Blow, and Raging Thrust in quick succession. The level of the skills used is equal to the number of Stigmata stacks on the target at the end of the cast.

If the target of Flash Combo has 10 stacks of Stigmata, the skill Furious Guillotine is added to the end of the combo. Stigmata stacks generated by the combo are not counted for either of the above effects.
This skill's Cast Time cannot be reduced. Costs 150 SP at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Flash Combo.requires: Burning Faith Lv5, Judge's Conviction Lv5, Furious Execution Lv10

desc: Enchants the user's weapons to be unnaturally sharp, increasing the user's Crit Rate and adding Dexterity scaling to all Assassin skills. Does not stack with other Blade Enchants.
Costs 20 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Delivers a slash faster than the eye can track, dealing damage that ignores Flee and scaling heavily with INT and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the First Art status. If Second Art or Third Art are active, this skill gains 30 bonus Crit rate. If both are active, it gains 100 bonus Crit rate instead, Second Art ends, and Echoing Shadow has it's cooldown reset.
8 second cooldown at all levels.
Specialization in the creation and modification of plant-based life. Each level increases the stats of summoned Plants, while also enhancing the effects of all Flora skills.

The user whirls their sword in a wide arc, dealing damage in a 7x7 area around the user and inflicting the Bleeding status for 5 seconds on all enemies struck (100% chance). Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Luck.
* If the user is in Vanguard Stance, the damage is treated as Bleeding Damage. * If the user is in Warden Stance, the duration of Bleeding is doubled.
Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of the stat granted by the active Stance. Requires a One or Two-Handed Sword.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Throws a volley of projectiles at the targeted enemy, gaining different effects based on the equipped Throwing Weapon. The damage deals an additional 3% Atk per point of Str and Int. Affects a 5x5 / 7x7 / 9x9 area (the wider areas coming from the Huuma bonuses below).

* Shuriken: ** First Art or Third Art: gains bonus Crit Rate. ** Both: is guaranteed to Crit, both Arts end, and Shifting Shadow's duration is increased by 1 second per target. ** Second Art only: autocasts Echoing Shadow on all targets struck, then refreshes the cooldowns of Echoing Shadow and Departing Shadow. * Kunai: ** First Art or Third Art: has a 50% chance to inflict the Kunai's status effect. ** Both: the chance is 100%, both Arts end, and Shifting Shadow's duration is increased by 1 second per target. ** Second Art only: inflicts Slow on all targets struck, then refreshes the cooldowns of Echoing Shadow and Departing Shadow. * Huuma: ** First Art or Third Art: the area of effect is increased. ** Both: the area is increased further, both Arts end, and Shifting Shadow's duration is increased by 1 second per target. ** Second Art only: the skill gains 50% card-like Defense Pierce and refreshes the cooldowns of Echoing Shadow and Departing Shadow.
Statuses inflicted last 5 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user unleashes a barrage of arcane energy, dealing Neutral property Magic damage to the target and all enemies in a 9x9 area, with 30% additional final damage against targets suffering from the Breach status. The damage is heavily influenced by the user's remaining SP (−30% to +30%): above half of Max SP it deals increased damage in proportion to how much remains, and below half it deals reduced damage. This skill's element changes to match the current Weapon Endow, and it gains Stat Scaling of 1% MATK per point of the stat granted by the active Endow. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

Creates and hurls numerous projectiles of pure force at a distant target, dealing Physical Neutral property damage. The damage inflicted is calculated using the caster's Magic Attack, but is reduced by the target's Physical Defense. Deals 30% additional damage if the target is Vulnerable. Damage is increased by 0.5% MATK per point of Strength. Has a cast time of 0.1s FCT plus 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.

The user inscribes an arcane sigil on the ground that channels incredible raw magic: for 5 seconds, the sigil immobilizes all enemies within its 9x9 range, dealing constant Neutral property Magic damage every 0.5 seconds, but the user is also immobilized while it is active. The damage is heavily influenced by the user's remaining SP (−30% to +30%): above half of Max SP it deals increased damage in proportion to how much remains, and below half it deals reduced damage. This skill's element changes to match the current Weapon Endow, and it gains Stat Scaling of 0.5% MATK per point of the stat granted by the active Endow. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Enables the user to walk and attack at reduced speed while casting spells. The penalty to Movement and Attack Speed is reduced at higher levels.

The caster unleashes a blast of frigid air at the target location, dealing Water property damage and attempting to inflict the Chilled status for 5 seconds on all enemies in the area. All enemies struck also suffer from Water Vulnerability (30% strength) for 10 seconds. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point of Vitality. Has a cast time of 0.1s FCT plus 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Deals a modest amount of Water property damage to a single target.
When cast, this skill takes the level of Magical Attunement instead of it's own level for determining damage, which also gains a bonus based on the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art satus. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, First Art Ends, and Flashing Steel has it's cooldown reset.
All Basic Ninja Arts share a Cooldown.
Has an SP cost of 25 and a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Administers a drug that sends the target into a battle rage, massively increasing their Defense Pierce and Magic Defense Pierce, but greatly reducing their Max HP and Max SP (side effects reduced by Stimulant Research). If cast at level 3 or higher, also generates one Extort and grants the target +10% Movement Speed for the duration. This skill's duration is 15 seconds per Extort stack the user has, but the stacks are not consumed. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 40 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user unleashes a blast of frigid ice, dealing Water Property Damage to all enemies in the targeted location.
* First Art: this skill's Fixed Cast Time is removed. * Second Art: this skill's Variable Cast Time is removed. * Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Winter's Grasp at Level 5.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Matk per point of Str and Dex. Affects a 9x9 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.

Conjures a blast of frigid air, inflicting a small amount of Water property damage to the target and all enemies in the surrounding area, with a high chance of leaving anyone struck Chilled. The debuff duration is 5 seconds.

The user unleashes a blast of freezing magic around themselves, dealing Water property Magic damage in an 11x11 area with 30% additional final damage against Chilled enemies. Applies the Water Affinity status on the user for 30 seconds: while active, all Water property Magic gains increased Magic Defense Pierce. Only one Affinity can be active at a time. Damage is increased by 5% MATK per point of Vit. Has a cast time of 4s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user summons spikes of ice at the target's location, dealing Water property Magic damage in a 7x7 area. Any Chilled enemies struck take 30% additional final damage; otherwise, this skill has a chance to inflict the Chilled status for 10 seconds. If the user is in Water Affinity, this skill additionally inflicts the Slow status and the duration of Water Affinity is refreshed. Damage is increased by 3% MATK per point of Vit. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Unloads the shotgun in a huge blast, dealing massive damage to enemies in a 5x5 cell area. Both enemies struck by the blast and the user are knocked back 5 cells. Enemies struck have a chance of being inflicted with Internal Bleeding for 5 seconds. Slowed and Vulnerable enemies have a chance of being Stunned for 3 seconds.
Has a cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
Delivers a lightning fast strike, dealing damage to a single target. This skill deals additional damage equal to 3% per point of Int and Dex.

* Second Art or Third Art: this skill gains a 30% bonus Crit Chance. * Both: the skill is guaranteed to Crit, both Arts end, and the next skill the user casts has its cooldown removed. * First Art only: Flashing Steel and Soaring Steel have their cooldowns refreshed, and the active cooldown of Mikiri is reduced.
Each level of this skill learned passively increases the damage of Flashing Steel.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user unleashes a rapid barrage of vicious strikes against a single target, dealing heavy damage and inflicting 2 stacks of Stigmata for 5 seconds.
* Discipline: this skill is guaranteed to Crit. * Iron Fists: this skill instantly refreshes the cooldown of Furious Thrust.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% Atk per point of Agi.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user delivers a crushing blow to the enemy, dealing exceptional Physical damage and inflicting 3 stacks of Stigmata for 5 seconds.
* Discipline: this skill is guaranteed to Crit. * Iron Fists: this skill splashes in a 5x5 area.
This skill consumes the Discipline and Iron Fists statuses, but does not grant them. This skill deals additional damage equal to 3% Atk per point of Agi.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user sings a furious note, consuming their current Rhythm to trigger all of their Melodic Marks with devastating force: deals enormous Hybrid damage, 150% + 15% per level, for each Rhythm level consumed, to all Marked enemies in range, then refreshes the Mark's duration. This skill fails if the user's Rhythm level is at zero. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Agi and 2% MATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Furious Finale.requires: Sonorant Spike Lv5, Ruinous Rhapsody Lv5

desc: The user delivers a deadly finishing blow to the target, dealing massive Physical damage and inflicting the Stun status at a 100% chance for 2 seconds.
Deals 1000% damage, with additional damage equal to 5% Atk per point of Agi. This skill does not benefit from the Iron Fists or Discipline statuses, nor does it grant them.
This skill cannot be learned. It is here for informational purposes only, it is automatically added to the end of Flash Combo when its target has 10 stacks of Stigmata.
The user throws a quick jab, delivering tremendous force with the minimum motion possible. Deals Physical damage to a single target, inflicting 1 stack of Stigmata for 5 seconds.
* Discipline: this skill is guaranteed to Crit. * Iron Fists: this skill grants the Aspersio status for 30 seconds.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% Atk per point of Agi.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Perfection through extremity. The user focuses all their might into delivering explosive performance, increasing the force they are capable of bringing to bear. Activates the Fury status for 10 minutes. While active, every time the user gains the Discipline or Iron Fists status, if it matches the last of the two activated, the stack count of Fury increases by 1; if it does not match, the stack count is reduced to zero. For each stack of Fury, the user's Strength and Luck are increased by 1 and their Crit Rate by 3.
Costs 150 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user fires a hail of arrows, calling them to rain down on their targets with a vicious wind. Deals heavy Physical damage across an 11x11 area with a chance to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds on all targets struck. Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Strength. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

Delivers a powerful flurry of stabs to the target and all enemies around them, dealing exceptional damage. Deals 50% additional final damage to Vulnerable enemies. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity.
* If the user is in Vanguard Stance, refreshes the cooldowns of Pierce, Spear Stab, and Brandish Spear. * If the user is in Warden Stance, all enemies struck are Stunned for 2 seconds (100% chance).
Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of the stat granted by the active Stance. Requires a One or Two-Handed Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
Gatling Pierce.requires: Phantom Thrust Lv5, Clashing Spiral Lv5

desc: The user creates a powerful tremor that shakes the ground beneath them, dealing Earth Property Magic Damage to all enemies in the area around them.

* First Art or Second Art: the Fixed Cast Time of this skill is removed. * Both: the entire cast time is removed, both Arts end, and enemies struck receive the Vulnerable status at a 100% chance for 5 seconds. * Third Art only: enemies struck become vulnerable to Fire Property attacks for 10 seconds, then all Basic and Advanced Ninja Arts have their cooldowns refreshed.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Matk per point of Str and Dex. Affects a 9x9 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.

Invokes a burst of flame on the target's location, dealing Physical Fire property damage to enemies in the area with a chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Intelligence, plus 3% final damage per level of Fauna Specialization. If the Homunculus Dieter is present, this skill consumes the user's Extort stacks to deal an additional 200% ATK per stack; otherwise, it generates one stack of Extort. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Sacrifices 25% of the user's Max HP to heal all allies in the area, with bonus healing of 5% per level of Fauna Specialization. If the Homunculus Eira is present, this skill consumes the user's Extort stacks to reduce its cooldown by 20% per stack; otherwise, it generates one stack of Extort. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

Shines a holy light on the user and their summoned entities, curing the Bleeding, Burning, Poison, Slow, Vulnerable, and Blind statuses and shielding against them for the duration (1 second per level, plus 0.5 seconds per level of Fauna Specialization). If the Homunculus Bayeri is present, this skill consumes the user's Extort stacks to also reduce all damage taken by 10% per stack for the duration; otherwise, it generates one stack of Extort. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Draws out the user's inner savage nature, massively increasing the Crit Rate of themselves and their summoned entities for 30 seconds, plus 3 seconds per level of Fauna Specialization. If the Homunculus Eleanor is present, this skill consumes the user's Extort stacks to also grant 10% Defense Pierce per stack (treated as card-like Defense Pierce for stacking purposes); otherwise, it generates one stack of Extort. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Creates a pool of toxic venom on the ground, dealing constant Poison damage in 3 hits (plus 1 hit per Extort stack) to enemies within, with a chance to inflict the Slow status. Damage is increased by 0.5% ATK per point of Intelligence and by 3% per level of Fauna Specialization. If the Homunculus Sera is present, this skill consumes the user's Extort stacks to increase its duration; otherwise, it generates one stack of Extort. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Performs a lengthy ritual to call on the spirits of nature, summoning a frigid wind at the user's location. For 10 minutes across a 31x31 area, all Water damage is increased and all Fire damage is decreased, and all creatures gain 3% Defense and Magic Defense Pierce per level of Ritual Mastery. Casting this skill disables all other Nature Rituals for 60 seconds; only one Nature Ritual can be active at a time. Has a base cast time of 10s FCT, reduced by Ritual Mastery.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
The user calls down swords of divine light to tear apart the targeted enemy, dealing Weapon Property Physical Damage to the target three times.
* Aspersio: this skill gains 30 bonus Crit Rate. * Grace: consumed to inflict the Stun status for 2 seconds. * Authority: consumed to inflict the Bleeding status for 10 seconds.
Statuses are inflicted at a 100% chance. This skill does not take the skill level of the user's Grace or Authority status. This skill deals additional damage equal to 3% Atk per point of Dex.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

The user sings a hymn of praise, lending divine strength to their allies. Increases the Crit Rate and ASPD Limit of all party members for 30 seconds. The duration of this skill is increased by 3 seconds per level of the user's Divine Grace.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 2.5s VCT.

The user calls down the wrath of God on a single target, dealing exceptional damage that ignores Defense and bypasses all elemental resistances. The Physical portion is increased by 3% ATK per point of Vitality.

* During Castigating Aura, this skill additionally inflicts the Vulnerable and Breach statuses for 10 seconds (100% chance). * During Providence, this skill inflicts additional damage of 20% of the user's Current HP per level, capped at 30,000 HP.
Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Gloria Domini.requires: Rapid Smiting Lv3, Ray of Judgement Lv3

desc: The user chants a healing prayer, bestowing a restorative miracle on the targeted ally. Restores a significant amount of HP for the target, then grants them a Barrier that protects them from further damage for 5 seconds. The amount of HP healed is based on the user's Base Level, Int, Vit, Magic Attack, and skill level, with an additional 1% Healing Power per point of Vit. The Barrier has HP equal to the amount healed.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds, reduced by 1 second per level of Divine Grace. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 3s VCT.
The user calls divine wrath down on the target, striking them and all enemies in a 7x7 area around them for massive damage, increased by the user's Dexterity.
* During Castigating Aura, deals 50% additional final damage. * During Providence, all enemies struck are Stunned for 2 seconds (100% chance).
Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user channels immense holy energies through their body, dealing five hits of Holy property damage to all nearby enemies. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity, and each hit has a chance to inflict the Blind and Vulnerable statuses. This skill gains no benefit from Int or MATK. Has a cast time of 0.5 + 1 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user opens a gate to the Netherworld, consuming all of their Void Spheres to open a portal on all enemies within a 27x27 area, dealing Undead property damage every second for 1 second per Void Sphere consumed. The user is healed for 100 HP per level for each Void Sphere consumed. If Void Infusion: Undead is active, this skill's Fixed Cast Time is removed. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point each of Agility and Vitality. Has a cast time of 4s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Grasping Death.requires: Death Eater Lv5, Death Circle Lv5

desc: Amplifies gravity at the targeted location, repeatedly striking all enemies within with crushing force. The damage inflicted is Physical Neutral property, calculated using the user's Magic Attack but reduced by the target's Physical Defense. Each hit briefly slows the target (this slow effect is not treated as the Slow status) and has a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds, reducing Defense by 40%. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point of Strength. Has a cast time of 0.1s FCT plus 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Tosses a Throwable Potion at the designated area, scattering its contents and healing all allies in a 7x7 area. Uses the same Potions as Aid Potion. The amount healed scales with the target's Vitality. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 30 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Strikes at a distant foe, dealing splash damage in a 5x5 area and attempting to inflict a status effect based on the currently active Blade Enchant:
* Rejuvenating Blades: Inflicts Slow. * Toxic Blades: Inflicts Poison. * Flashing Blades: Inflicts Blind.
Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Katar.
Has a base cooldown of 4 seconds at all levels.
The user raises their shield in a defensive stance, blocking all physical attacks for 3 seconds. Requires a Shield.
Costs 20 SP at all levels.

The user sacrifices 50% of their current HP to create a protective Barrier shielding all party members for 5 seconds, with HP equal to a percentage of the HP consumed. If this skill is mastered, it passively reduces the cooldown of Guardian Stance by 10 seconds. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.

The user shifts into a defensive stance for 5 seconds, heavily reducing all damage they receive and increasing their maximum Attack Speed, but preventing the use of all skills. When the stance ends, the user is healed for a portion of their missing HP.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user focuses all of their strength into a single blow, exhausting every last drop of energy they have to deliver fatal damage to a single enemy. Consumes the user's remaining SP to do massive Physical Damage, which is increased by 1% Total Damage per 1% of Missing HP on the target.
* Iron Fists: this skill is guaranteed to Crit and ignores Defense. * Discipline: the damage is dealt based on the user's Max SP instead of their remaining SP.
This skill can only deal damage to a single target once every five minutes. This skill's Cast Time cannot be reduced by skills or items.
Costs 100% of the user's current SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.

The user focuses all of their efforts on offense, discarding any pretense for self preservation. For 10 seconds, all skills have their cooldowns reduced to 1 second, but the user is immobilized. This status ends after a certain number of skills have been cast. Does not stack with Bullet Time.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.
The user wraps themselves in shadows and illusions, making them all but impossible to strike with ordinary attacks. Increases the user's Perfect Dodge by 100 for 5 seconds.
Costs 25 SP at all levels.

The user slams the ground with their weapon, sending out shockwaves that deal damage in a 7x7 area with a chance to inflict Stun for 3 seconds on all enemies struck. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Vitality. Generates one stack of Extort. Requires an Axe or Two-Handed Axe.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user fires an explosive round from their Rifle, damaging and attempting to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds on all enemies in a 5x5 area around their target.
* Rifle Specialization: this skill consumes the Crimson Marker status from all targets struck to increase its damage by 50% Final Damage. * Otherwise: this skill inflicts the Crimson Marker status.
This skill generates 1 Grenade, and is refreshed by Rapid Reload if you have a Rifle equipped. Requires a Rifle.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT.

Fires a remarkably heavy arrow at the target, attempting to ward off their advance. Deals damage to a single target and generates one Preparation Counter. Knocks the target back 2 cells, plus 1 cell per Preparation Counter the user has. If the user has three Preparation Counters when this skill is cast, the cooldown of Razor Shot is instantly refreshed. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Vitality. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Performs a joint maneuver with the user's Falcon, striking a single target in unison: the falcon strikes the target, dealing Weapon property Physical damage, while the user gains a boost to their Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Whenever the user performs a basic attack with a bow, this skill has a chance to trigger at half damage (1% per level, plus 0.1% per point of Luk). Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Agility. Requires a Bow and a Falcon.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
Instantly restores the target's HP. Recovery amount is based on Skill Level, INT, and Base Level.
Cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Fires a barrage of weighted arrows into the sky to rain down on the target and all enemies in a 9x9 area. All enemies struck have a chance to be Stunned for 2 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point each of Strength and Vitality. For each Preparation Counter the user has, this skill's cast time is reduced by 1s FCT + 1s VCT and its damage is increased (10%/25%/50% final damage at 1/2/3 Counters); all Preparation Counters are then lost. This skill requires at least one Preparation Counter to cast. Has a base cast time of 5s FCT + 5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Heaven's Arrow.requires: Hammer Shot Lv5, Razor Shot Lv5

desc: Causes numerous stone spikes to explode out of the ground at the targeted location, dealing Earth property damage and attempting to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds on all enemies in the area. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point of Dexterity. Has a cast time of 0.1s FCT plus 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user launches a salvo of homing grenades in a wide area, dealing heavy Physical Damage to all enemies under the Crimson Marker status within a 21x21 range. The damage dealt by this skill is treated as Burning Damage, and all enemies struck have a chance of being inflicted with the Slow status for 5 seconds.
Requires 1 Grenade and a Grenade Launcher equipped in the sub-weapon slot.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s VCT.

The user sings a majestic song to steel the party's resolve, consuming all of the user's Rhythm to provide massive buffs to offense and defense for all party members in a 31x31 area. The buff lasts 60 seconds per Rhythm level consumed. Does not stack with Ardent Anthem. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 90 seconds at all levels.
Hero's Hymn.requires: Bard: Quickening Chorus Lv5, Restorative Refrain Lv5 / Dancer: Noetic Number Lv5, Savage Stride Lv5

desc: The user delivers a divine smite backed by the crushing weight of their shield, dealing Weapon property Melee Physical damage increased by 3% ATK per point of Vitality and by the user's Vulnerable Potency. Inflicts the Vulnerable status for an extended 10-second duration (100% chance).
* During Castigating Aura, this skill is guaranteed to be Critical. * During Providence, this skill inflicts the Stun status.
Requires a Shield.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
Hesperus Lit.requires: Rapid Smiting Lv3, Ray of Judgement Lv3

desc: Quickly conceals the user underground, avoiding the majority of physical and magical attacks. Has a short duration and long cooldown, both of which can be improved by leveling the skill.
Costs 10 SP at all levels.

Delivers a swift series of two Holy element attacks. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Dexterity, and is further increased by 30% final damage if the enemy is suffering from the Bleeding or Blind statuses. Requires a Spear or Two-Handed Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 6 seconds at all levels.
Holy Cross.requires: Brilliant Strike Lv3, Spear Flurry Lv3

desc: Manifests a burst of Holy energy to smite an enemy. Deals additional damage if the user is under the Aspersio status.
Cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.
Cast Time: 0.2FCT + 0.8VCT
Enables the user to craft Homunculi at the Alchemist's Guild, while also improving their stats. Homunculi each have unique stats, except their Hit Rate is based on the Alchemist's total Hit Rate.
The user spins wildly with their weapons, striking all enemies in the area around them.

* Toxic Blades: this skill's cooldown is reduced for each enemy struck suffering from the Poison status. * Flashing Blades: inflicts the Blind status for 5 seconds. * Rejuvenating Blades: grants the user the Endure effect for 3 seconds. * Fatal Blades: this skill is guaranteed to be Critical against Poisoned enemies.
This skill gains Stat Scaling of 3% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Applies a musical blessing to the target for 5 seconds per level, providing a small increase to their Base Stats and marking them to receive bonuses from the user's other skills. If cast on someone other than the user, the effect is applied to the user as well. The All Stats bonus is equal to the user's Rhythm level when the buff was applied, but cannot exceed the learned level of this skill. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.

Invokes the power of the Sowilo Rune, the rune of the Sun, to create a blast of mystical fire from the user's weapon, dealing Weapon property Physical damage in a 7x7 area around the user. Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Int, and by 10% of the user's Burning Damage bonuses per level of Rune Research.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Hurls a holy spear at a distant target up to 9 cells away, dealing Physical damage with a chance to inflict the Bleeding status for 5 seconds. If the target is Blind, deals 30% additional final damage and immobilizes the target for 2 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dexterity. This skill is affected by Spear Flurry. Requires a Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Invokes a miracle of restoration on the party through the laying of hands. Immediately removes the Burning, Bleeding, Poison, and Searing Light statuses from the entire party, and grants immunity to those statuses for a short duration. The cooldown is 60 seconds, reduced by 3 seconds per level of Divine Grace. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Restores a small amount of HP every 10 seconds while not moving, and increases the healing effectiveness of restorative items.
The user improvises a melody, reaching a crescendo in their performance exactly when it's needed most. Immediately sets the user's Rhythm Level to a fixed value. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.

The user deploys a trap that lasts 15 seconds and triggers on contact, dealing Fire property damage with a high chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds on all enemies in a 5x5 area. Damage is greatly improved by the user's Intelligence, increased by 3% ATK per point of Intelligence. Has a cast time of 3.5s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Throws a mix of volatile chemicals that ignite on contact at the targeted location, dealing rapid Fire property damage over time in a 7x7 area. The damage is treated as Burning damage, and is increased by 0.5% ATK per point of Intelligence. For each Extort stack the user has, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1 second (base 10 seconds). Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

The user utters a prayer of confidence, bolstering their faith and preparing to put it to work in feats of great spiritual prowess. Passively reduces the damage the user takes from any enemy under the Stigmata status.

When activated, grants the user the Indomitable Faith status, during which Soul Piercer, Spiritual Lash, and Soul Quake inflict 1 stack of Stigmata and are treated as Sura skills for Stigmata's damage boosting effect. The active effect does not stack with Burning Faith.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Consumes a portion of the user's Max HP to instantly regenerate SP equal to 50% of the HP consumed.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Summons a raging inferno to scorch the targeted 7x7 location, inflicting Fire property damage over time to all enemies within. Enemies suffering from the Burning status take 30% increased damage. Damage is increased by 0.5% MATK per point of Luck. Only one Land Spell can be active at a time. Has a cast time of 0.2s FCT + 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
Strikes the target with an intimidating blow, attempting to inflict the Bleeding, Burning, and Poison statuses. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Luck.
Has a base cooldown of 6 seconds at all levels.

The user passes judgement on all nearby enemies, preparing them for punishment. Inflicts Stigmata stacks on all enemies in a 7x7 area around the user, lasting 5 seconds. For each stack of Stigmata on an enemy, all Sura skills that target them deal 1% increased damage. A target can have a maximum of 10 stacks of Stigmata on them at once.
Additionally, each level learned passively increases the duration of all Stigmata stacks inflicted by the user by 0.5 seconds.
The number of stacks inflicted is Skill Level / 2; the table below assumes fractions round down. [fixme: rounding is not defined in the lub, and rounding down would inflict 0 stacks at level 1]
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Fires a ball of concentrated electricity at an enemy, dealing Wind property damage, knocking them back, and inflicting the Wind Vulnerability status (30% strength) for 10 seconds. Deals 30% additional damage to enemies suffering from Sleep. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point of Agility. Has a cast time of 0.1s FCT plus 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Increases the damage and Hit Rate of Katar class weapons. While a Katar is equipped, the user's Crit Rate is doubled.

The caster offers a prayer for divine protection, calling on heavenly powers to protect the target from all harm. For the duration, all damage taken by the target is halved. The cooldown is 60 seconds, reduced by 3 seconds per level of Divine Grace. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Kyrie Eleison.requires: Aspersio Lv3, Renovatio Lv3, Impositio Manus Lv3

desc: Swings the weapon around wildly to knock nearby enemies away, giving room to breathe before re-engaging. Restores HP for each enemy struck.

The user unleashes a string of rapid Spirit skills, using Soul Piercer, Spiritual Lash, and Soul Quake in quick succession. The level of the skills cast is equal to the number of Stigmata stacks on the target at the end of the cast.
If the target has 10 stacks of Stigmata, the skill Zealous Pyre is added to the end of the combo. Stigmata stacks generated by the combo are not counted for either of the above effects.
This skill's Cast Time cannot be reduced. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Last Exorcism.requires: Indomitable Faith Lv5, Judge's Conviction Lv5, Zealous Rage Lv10

desc: The user spins their Gatling Gun to fire on all enemies in a 9x9 area around them, dealing damage and knocking them back. Enemies struck have a high chance of being Slowed for 5 seconds.
Requires a Gatling Gun in the sub-weapon slot.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s VCT.
Calls down bolts of lightning on a distant target, dealing Wind property damage. Deals additional damage to targets suffering from the Sleep status.

The user responds instantly to an incoming attack, blocking a single Physical skill against them within a 1-second window. If a skill is blocked, the user gains a benefit based on the level of this skill that was cast (see below). This skill has no effect against autoattacks or Magical skills.
Costs 25 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

rows: Inflicts Blind; refreshes Deft Stab and Ricochet Knife
Inflicts Vulnerable; refreshes Blindside and Scorpion Lash
User enters Cloaking; refreshes Breakout and Fire Cracker
Stalker's Instinct cooldown reduced by 10 seconds

desc: Summons a barrage of lightning bolts that rain down on the targeted area, doing heavy Wind property damage and possibly inflicting the Sleep status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point of Agility. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 2s VCT, plus an additional 0.15s FCT + 0.5s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the Moon into a single devastating strike, dealing Physical damage increased by 3% Atk per point of Vit and healing for a portion of the damage dealt. If the user is in the Cloaking status, this skill deals double damage.

* Solar Heat: the damage is treated as Burning Damage, but bonuses to Burning Damage are significantly reduced (33% of the bonus is applied). * Stellar Blessing: the attack ignores the target's Defense. * Umbral Veil: the attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the Moon, striking a single enemy and then veiling themselves from sight. Deals Physical damage that is increased by 3% Atk per point of Vit and heals the user for a portion of the damage dealt, after which the user is put in the Cloaking status for a brief time.

* Solar Heat: the damage is treated as Burning Damage, but bonuses to Burning Damage are significantly reduced (33% of the bonus is applied). * Stellar Blessing: the attack ignores the target's Defense. * Umbral Veil: the attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user shines with the light of the moon, concentrating it into their hands and feet to deal a powerful blow to a single enemy while infusing themselves with defensive energies. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Vit. If the user is suffering from Blind, Vulnerable, or Slow, those statuses are removed; otherwise, they gain immunity to those statuses for 5 seconds.

* If cast while Lunar Protection is active, the attack restores life equal to a portion of the user's Maximum HP. * If used during Counter Stance, this skill cannot miss and bypasses skills like Guard. * If used during Axe Stance, this skill triggers the Cloaking status for a short duration.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user infuses themselves with the protective essence of the Moon for 10 minutes, reducing the damage they take from Poison, Bleeding, and Burning, while also granting resistance to the Bleeding and Vulnerable statuses. While this Alignment is active, Counter Kick and Axe Kick deal additional total damage of 1% per point of the user's Vit. Does not stack with other Cosmic Alignments.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
The user is blessed by the eternal light of Heaven, granting them unprecedented strength in calling down holy wrath on their foes.

If the user is under the Authority status, they gain the Grace status of the same level. If they are already under the Grace status, the level of the Grace status is increased instead, up to a maximum Grace level of 15. This skill does not take the user's Grace status to determine its own level.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
The user is blessed by the divine light of Heaven, granting them the ability to call on unprecedented miracles to aid their allies.

If the user is under the Grace status, they gain the Authority status of the same level. If they are already under the Authority status, the level of that status is increased instead, up to a maximum Authority level of 15. This skill does not take the user's Authority status to determine its own level.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
The user chants a heartfelt prayer, bestowing a sheltering miracle on their party for 20 seconds.
* Grace: consumed to apply a buff that heals all party members whenever they receive damage. * Authority: consumed to apply a buff that heals all party members whenever they deal damage.

The amount of HP healed is increased by 5 per point of the user's Vit. Whenever healing occurs from this skill, the original caster loses 30 SP, and the status ends early if the caster runs out of SP. This skill does not take the skill level of the user's Grace or Authority status.

The user fires a projectile in the form of a great stone dragon toward the targeted enemy, dealing Earth Property Damage to them and all enemies in a straight line.
* First Art: this skill's Fixed Cast Time is removed. * Second Art: this skill's Variable Cast Time is removed. * Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Seismic Collapse at Level 5.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Matk per point of Str and Dex. Affects a 5x9 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.

Delivers a powerful series of four blows to an enemy. This skill can be cast freely and does not require a combo state. Damage is increased by 1% per point of Agility. If the user is under the Iron Fists status, the cooldown of this skill is halved. If the user is under the Discipline status, this skill is guaranteed to Crit and deals additional damage of 1% per point of Intelligence.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Delivers a single devastating blow to an enemy. This skill can be cast freely and does not require a combo state. Damage is increased by 2% per point of Agility. If the user is under the Iron Fists status, the cooldown of this skill is halved. If the user is under the Discipline status, this skill is guaranteed to Crit and deals additional damage of 2% per point of Intelligence. Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

If the user is under the Iron Fists status, the cooldown of this skill is halved. If the user is under the Discipline status, this skill is guaranteed to Crit and deals additional damage of 1% per point of Intelligence.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
The user delivers a whirling blow, striking all enemies in a 5x5 area around them for moderate physical damage. This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% per point of Agi.
* Discipline: this skill is guaranteed to Crit, grants double the level of Iron Fists, and deals additional damage equal to 2% per point of Int. * Iron Fists: this skill's cooldown is halved.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

The user dashes behind an enemy, delivering a quick hail of bullets into their back. Teleports behind a target before dealing moderate Physical Damage, with a chance to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds. If the target is already Slowed, instead inflicts Vulnerable. This skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Bleeding enemies.
This skill is refreshed by Rapid Reload if you have a Revolver equipped. Requires a Revolver.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The caster utters a small incantation to accelerate their own speech and actions, rapidly increasing the speed at which they can cast spells. Reduces the Fixed Cast Time of all spells by 3 seconds for 5 seconds.
Costs 100 SP at all levels.
Rapidly reloads the equipped weapon, instantly refreshing the cooldowns of certain skills depending on the type of weapon equipped. 25 SP cost at all levels.
Revolver: Quick Draw and Rapid Shower
Rifle: Breaking Shot and Snipe
Shotgun: Scatter Shot and Full Blast

Unleases a hail of bullets at the target, dealing Ranged Physical damage and attempting to inflict Slow for 5 seconds. If the target is Vulnerable or Bleeding, the skill's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds.
The user hurls their shield at a distant target, striking them multiple times. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Vitality.
* During Castigating Aura, this skill deals additional damage based on the user's Vulnerable Potency. * During Providence, this skill immobilizes the target for 2 seconds.
Requires a Shield. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Fires a tremendous volley of arrows at a distant location, repeatedly striking all enemies in an 11x11 area for 4 seconds. Casting this skill consumes the user's Rhythm to reduce the interval between hits (1 second, minus 0.15 seconds per Rhythm level consumed). Damage is increased by 0.5% ATK per point of Agility. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
The user lashes out around them, dealing heavy physical damage to all enemies in a 9x9 area. This skill deals additional damage equal to 3% per point of Int and Dex.

* Second Art or Third Art: this skill gains a 30% bonus Crit Chance. * Both: the skill is guaranteed to Crit, both Arts end, and the user heals 10% of their Max HP for each enemy struck. * First Art only: Flashing Steel and Soaring Steel have their cooldowns refreshed, and the active cooldown of Mikiri is reduced.
Each level of this skill learned passively increases the damage of Soaring Steel.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user fires a beam of holy light at the target, dealing Weapon property Ranged Physical damage increased by 2% ATK per point of Vitality.
* During Castigating Aura, this skill also inflicts the Severe Burning status for 5 seconds. * During Providence, this skill also inflicts the Slow status for 5 seconds.
Requires a Shield. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Fires a serrated arrow to tear through the target, attempting to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds. Deals damage to a single target and generates one Preparation Counter. If the user has three Preparation Counters when this skill is cast, the cooldown of Piercing Shot is instantly refreshed. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Strength. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
The user fires a blast of razor sharp wind, slicing through all enemies in the area in front of them.

* First Art or Second Art: the Fixed Cast Time of this skill is removed. * Both: the entire cast time is removed, both Arts end, and enemies struck receive the Bleeding status at a 100% chance for 5 seconds. * Third Art only: enemies struck become vulnerable to Earth Property attacks for 10 seconds, then all Basic and Advanced Ninja Arts have their cooldowns refreshed.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Matk per point of Str and Dex. Affects a 3x9 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.
Instantly moves the user to the targeted location, if they have line of sight. If the appropriate Finisher Skill of the equipped weapon is on cooldown, it's cooldown is refreshed.
Has a 25 SP cost at all levels.
The user throws a massive shuriken at the targeted enemy which ricochets between all enemies in a large 9x9 area. This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Atk per point of Str and Int.

* First Art and Second Art: all active Mirages immediately cast a random Basic Ninja Art at level 5 on the original target. * First Art and Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Piercing Shadow at the same level on the original target. * Second Art and Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Flashing Steel Level 5 on the original target.
This skill consumes all of the user's Ninja Arts, even if none of the above criteria are met.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.

Invokes the power of the Nauthiz Rune, the rune of Necessity, to accelerate the user's skill usage. For 10 seconds, the next skill cast by the user has its cooldown greatly reduced; this reduction ignores the Cooldown Cap. The cooldown of Refresh itself is 60 seconds, reduced by 3 seconds per level of Rune Research. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Costs 50 SP at all levels.

Enchants the user's weapons with restorative magic, causing all attacks to restore a portion of the damage dealt as HP for the user and adding Vitality scaling to all Assassin skills. Does not stack with other Blade Enchants.
Costs 20 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Delivers a savage blow to the enemy, exacerbating any weaknesses in their defense. If the target is Bleeding or Vulnerable, deals an additional 150% ATK for each status effect present and inflicts the opposite status effect for 5 seconds. Requires a Sword or Two-Handed Sword.
Has a base cooldown of 6 seconds at all levels.

Calls a blessed light of regeneration to shine on the party, recovering HP over time for 5 seconds for all party members in the area. The amount healed scales with Base Level, Int, and Magic Attack. The cooldown is 60 seconds, reduced by 4 seconds per level of Divine Grace. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Commands the party to rapidly shift their positioning, massively increasing the party's move speed for 5 seconds and removing any slowing effects.
Has a 60 second cooldown and 10 SP cost at all levels.

The user consecrates the ground at a target location, filling it with restorative holy energy for 5 seconds. All allies within the field are healed over time, with the amount increased by 5% of the target's Max HP. Has a cast time of 0.5 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.

Plays an uplifting yet gentle song to soothe the hearts of the party, restoring HP each second for 5 seconds to all party members in a 31x31 area. This skill is exclusive to Bards. Requires an Instrument. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user alters their fighting style to specialize in the use of revolvers. For 10 minutes, the user's Slow Potency is increased and Revolver skills are enhanced:
* Quick Draw: inflicts Vulnerable and Crimson Marker. * Rapid Shower: inflicts Internal Bleeding and Crimson Marker. * Unload: gains (Skill Level / 3) Grenades instead of 1.
This skill shares a cooldown with other Specializations. Requires a Revolver.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Fires a pulse of rhythmic magic, inflicting Magic damage to an enemy and altering the user's Rhythm level: below three, it is increased by one; above three, it is reduced by one; at exactly three, it is extended by 5 seconds; at zero, it is unaffected. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point of Luck. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user hurls a throwing knife at the designated target, which ricochets between them and all enemies in a 7x7 area. All enemies struck are inflicted with the Bleeding status for 5 seconds (100% chance). For each Burning target struck, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1 second. The damage is treated as Bleeding Damage, and is increased by 2% ATK per point of Luck.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user alters their fighting style to specialize in the use of rifles. For 10 minutes, the user's Vulnerable Potency is increased and Rifle skills are enhanced:
* Breaking Shot: inflicts Slow and Crimson Marker. * Snipe: inflicts Internal Bleeding and Crimson Marker. * Hammer Round: gains (Skill Level / 3) Grenades instead of 1.
This skill shares a cooldown with other Specializations. Requires a Rifle.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Mastery in performing rituals to call on the spirits of nature. Each level passively reduces the cast time of Nature Rituals cast by the user and increases their effects. When recasting a Nature Ritual that is already active, the entire cast time is removed instead.

The user performs a ritual to suppress the power of the spirits of nature, deadening their effects on the material world. The user immediately loses a large amount of AP, then gains a bonus to Attack Speed and a reduction to all SP Costs for a short duration.

The user performs a ritual to draw out the power of the spirits of nature, preparing to wield their might to create powerful phenomena in the physical world. The user immediately gains a large amount of AP, then for a short duration, their Crit Rate is increased and all of their Fixed Cast Times are reduced.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

Performs a lengthy ritual to call on the spirits of nature, summoning a tremendous windstorm at the user's location. Casting this skill disables all other Nature Rituals for 60 seconds; only one Nature Ritual can be active at a time. Has a base cast time of 10s FCT, reduced by Ritual Mastery.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Spins with an equipped dagger, slashing at all enemies in a 5x5 area around the user. Has a chance to inflict a status effect based on the currently active Blade Enchant:

Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Dagger.
Has a base cooldown of 4 seconds at all levels.
Delivers a spinning kick to a single target, carrying the user's momentum forward to continue delivering kicks in rapid succession.

Using this skill grants the Roundhouse Stance for 5 seconds, during which time the user's ASPD is massively enhanced. Roundhouse Stance ends when any other Stance ends or when Roundhouse Kick is cast again.
Has a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Skill in the creation and application of Rune Stones. Rune Stones are single-use items that can be slotted into equipment in the same manner as Cards. Rune Stones can be used by any class, but have additional effects for Rune Knights. Recipes for crafting Rune Stones must be discovered in the world.
Research into the usage of Runes, mystical symbols that can invoke supernatural effects. Boosts the effectiveness of all Rune Knight skills. This skill does not affect Rune creation or effectiveness.

The user delivers a precision strike, landing a savage blow under the opponent's guard. Deals Melee Physical damage to a single target and inflicts the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. If the user is in the Counter State, the attack deals additional damage based on their Vulnerable Potency.

* Toxic Blades: additionally inflicts the Poison status. * Flashing Blades: additionally inflicts the Bleeding status. * Rejuvenating Blades: additionally inflicts the Blind status. * Peerless Blades: subtracts 5 seconds from the active cooldown of Weapon Blocking.
Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Dagger.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
The user charges at a distant target, slamming into them and generating one stack of Extort. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Vitality.
Has a base cooldown of 3 seconds, increased by 2 seconds for each Extort stack currently held.

The user consecrates the ground beneath them for 30 seconds, bestowing it with holy properties. Allies within the area gain a temporary increase to Attack, Magic Attack, Defense, and Magic Defense, while enemies within the area periodically receive Holy property Physical damage, increased by 1% ATK per point of Vitality and 1% ATK per point of Dexterity.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.
Throws sand into the enemy's eyes, inflicting Neutral damage and attempting to inflict the Blind status for 5 seconds.
3 second cooldown at all levels.

The user throws a spinning blade at a distant target, dealing heavy Ranged Physical damage. If this skill strikes an enemy that is currently casting a skill, the user enters the Counter State for 5 seconds.

Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Dagger.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user performs a savagely beautiful dance, spurring the party on to acts of great violence. If Rhythm level is Even or zero, it increases by 1; if Odd, it decreases by 1. This skill is exclusive to Dancers. Requires a Whip. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

If the target is suffering from the Bleeding or Poison status, the active cooldown of Chaser's Respite is reduced by 0.5 seconds per level for each. Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Sprays fire from the shotgun over a 5x5 cell area, hitting multiple enemies with a high chance to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds. Slowed and Vulnerable enemies have a chance of being Stunned for 3 seconds.
Cooldown of 8 seconds at all levels.

The user emits a cone of fire in the targeted direction, scorching all enemies in its path. Deals Physical Damage five times that is treated as Burning Damage to all enemies it strikes. Requires 1 Grenade and a Grenade Launcher equipped in the sub-weapon slot.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s VCT.

For each Bleeding enemy struck, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1 second. The damage is treated as Poison Damage, and is increased by 2% ATK per point of Luck.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Calls sacred fire from the heavens to incinerate the target, inflicting damage to them over time. Damage per second is equal to (Int × Skill Level × Base Level / 100). This damage is increased by 50% if the target is Dark, Undead, or Ghost property, and is halved if the target is Holy property. The effect lasts 5 seconds, plus 0.5 seconds per level of Divine Authority. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Lunges at a distant target up to 9 cells away, dealing significant damage.

* Toxic Blades: also inflicts the Poison status for 5 seconds (100% chance). * Flashing Blades: this skill's cooldown is halved. * Rejuvenating Blades: the user's Movement Speed is increased by 25% for 3 seconds. * Fatal Blades: this skill is guaranteed to be Critical against Poisoned enemies.
This skill gains Stat Scaling of 3% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Deals a large amount of Earth property Magical damage in a 7x7 area around the caster with a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status.
When cast, takes the level of Advanced Ninjutsu Mastery instead of it's own level for determining damage, with an additional bonus that scales with the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art Status. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, Second Art ends, and Departing Shadow has it's cooldown reset.
Has an SP cost of 40 and a cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
All Advanced Ninja Arts share a cooldown.

Causes the earth to shake violently at the targeted location, dealing Earth property Magic damage over time in a 9x9 area with 30% additional final damage against Bleeding enemies. Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user focuses to purify their heart and mind, preparing to engage in combat with no distractions. Applies the Serenity status to the user, which increases their Intelligence and reduces all of their Fixed Cast Times for 10 minutes.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.

Fires an explosive shell at an enemy, tearing apart their defenses as well as their bodies. This skill deals 30% additional Final Damage to Slowed enemies.

Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 0.5s VCT.
Dashes to a distant target up to 9 cells away and delivers a powerful strike, shattering their defenses.

Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of the stat granted by the active Stance.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Hurls the shield at a distant enemy, attempting to throw them off balance and inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Vitality, and is further increased if the target is already Vulnerable. Requires a Shield.
Has a base cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.

The user slams their shield into the enemy, dealing Physical damage while also protecting the user: generates a Barrier lasting 3 seconds with HP equal to 25% of the damage dealt. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Vitality. Requires a Shield.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user launches their shield at a distant target while taking a defensive stance, dealing Ranged Physical damage and creating a Barrier lasting 3 seconds with HP equal to 25% of the damage dealt. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Vitality. Requires a Shield. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user smashes their shield into the enemy, dealing heavy damage that is increased by 1% ATK per point of Vitality. Deals 30% additional final damage if the target is Vulnerable. Requires a Shield.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user wraps themselves in an illusion, distorting space to obscure their movements. For 10 seconds, the user gains a bonus to their Dexterity. When this status ends, the user is teleported back to the location where they cast it, ignoring any obstacles between them and that location.

The teleport only occurs if the user is within 25 cells of the original cast location, and the effect is cancelled if the user changes maps. This skill can be cast again to end it early, and its cooldown does not begin until the status ends.
Costs 50 SP at all levels. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
The user alters their fighting style to specialize in the use of shotguns. For 10 minutes, the user's Bleeding Damage is increased and Shotgun skills are enhanced:
* Scatter Shot: inflicts Vulnerable and Crimson Marker. * Full Blast: inflicts Slow and Crimson Marker. * Slug Shot: gains (Skill Level / 3) Grenades instead of 1.
This skill shares a cooldown with other Specializations. Requires a Shotgun.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user deploys a trap that lasts 15 seconds and triggers on contact, dealing Neutral property damage with a high chance to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds on all enemies in a 5x5 area. Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Fires an arrow cloaked in a dark fog to inhibit the target's vision, attempting to inflict the Blind status for 5 seconds. Deals damage to a single target and generates one Preparation Counter. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Draws the sign of the cross, dealing Holy element damage in an area around the caster and enchanting their weapon with the Aspersio status for a short time. Scales with Physical and Magical attack.
SP Cost of 35 and cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user performs an alluring dance, distracting enemies into letting down their guard. Increases the damage taken by all enemies near the user by 10% for 10 seconds, increased by an additional 1% per 5 points of the user's Int. If Rhythm level is Even or zero, it increases by 1; if Odd, it decreases by 1. This skill is exclusive to Dancers. Requires a Whip. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

* Shotgun Specialization: this skill consumes the target's Crimson Marker status and inflicts Stun for 2 seconds. * Otherwise: this skill inflicts the Crimson Marker status.
This skill generates 1 Grenade, and is refreshed by Rapid Reload if you have a Shotgun equipped. Requires a Shotgun.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Infuses the user's weapon with holy might and smashes it into the foe. If the user is under the Aspersio status, the energy explodes after three seconds, dealing damage again to the target and all enemies in a 5x5 cell area around them.
Cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.

Has a long fixed cast time, but does exceptionally high damage that ignores the targets Flee and bypasses skills like Guard, and has a high chance to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. The final damage of this skill is increased by +25% for each of the Slowed or Bleeding statuses on the target.
Fixed Cast Time of 3s and a cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

The user braces themselves for incoming damage, preparing to stand their ground and fight no matter the odds. For the duration, the user takes 25% reduced damage from all attacks per Preparation Counter they have. If the user has three Preparation Counters when this skill is cast, it also removes most damaging status effects.
Costs 25 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Dashes through a distant target, delivering three quick strikes. The damage of this skill scales heavily with INT and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the First Art status, if Second Art or Third Art are active, this skill gains 30 bonus Crit rate. If both are active, instead gains 100 bonus Crit rate, Third Art ends, and Advanced Ninjutsu Arts type skills have their cooldowns reset.
Has a cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a range of 7 cells.

The user channels the power of the Sun into a single focused strike, drawing heat out from their target to intensify their burns. The skill takes half of the user's bonus to Burning Damage, and deals additional damage equal to 3% Atk per point of Int.

* Lunar Protection: the attack gains Life Steal equal to 20% of the damage dealt. * Stellar Blessing: the attack ignores the target's Defense. * Umbral Veil: the attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user infuses themselves with the heat of the Sun for 10 minutes, increasing the damage of the Burning status they inflict and increasing their resistance to the Burning and Chilled statuses. While this Alignment is active, Counter Kick and Roundhouse Kick deal additional total damage of 1% per point of the user's Int. Does not stack with other Cosmic Alignments.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the Sun, unleashing it in a blast centered on themselves. Deals Physical damage in a 9x9 area around the user, which gains half the user's bonuses to Burning Damage, deals additional damage equal to 3% Atk per point of Int, and has a chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds.
* Lunar Protection: the attack gains 10% Life Steal. * Stellar Blessing: the attack ignores the target's Defense. * Umbral Veil: the attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
The user delivers a blazing kick, inflicting endowable damage with a high chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Int.
