Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
The user pushes themselves to the limit, accelerating their body to the extreme. Increases the user's ASPD, Max ASPD, and Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Requires a Katar.
Costs 50 SP at all levels.
Delivers a flurry of blows with an equipped katar, dealing massive damage. This skill gains additional effects based on the currently active Blade Enchant:

* Rejuvenating Blades: Adds a chance to inflict Stun, increasing with skill level. * Toxic Blades: Total damage +5% per level of Toxic Blades against Poisoned enemies. * Flashing Blades: Ignores 50% of the target's defense.
Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant. Requires a Katar.
Has a base cooldown of 8 seconds at all levels.
The user uses their weapon to create a shockwave to strike a distant enemy up to 9 cells away, dealing Physical damage with additional effects based on the weapon equipped:

* If used with a Two-Handed Sword, additionally inflicts Bleeding for 5 seconds. * If used with a Two-Handed Spear, additionally inflicts Vulnerable for 5 seconds. * During Vanguard Stance, the user's Movement Speed is briefly increased after casting. * During Warden Stance, this skill also inflicts the Slow status.
Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of the stat granted by the active Stance. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user sings a screeching note, triggering all of their Melodic Marks at once: deals Physical Ranged damage to all Marked enemies within a 25x25 area, with a chance of 20% per Rhythm level to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds, then resets the duration of their Melodic Mark. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Agi. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user binds the power of the evil spirits around them into the Souls they wield, accelerating their ability to be used in combat. Consumes all of the user's active Spirits to reduce the active cooldowns of all of the user's skills by 1 second per Spirit consumed. This skill's cooldown can never be reduced.
Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.

The user attacks an enemy with a burst of raw magical energy that ignites on contact, dealing Neutral property Magic damage to a single target. If they are under the Breach status, this skill has a chance to inflict the Severe Burning status for 5 seconds. The damage is heavily influenced by the user's remaining SP (−30% to +30%): above half of Max SP it deals increased damage in proportion to how much remains, and below half it deals reduced damage. This skill's element changes to match the current Weapon Endow, and it gains Stat Scaling of 1% MATK per point of the stat granted by the active Endow. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Summons a horde of vengeful souls to a targeted enemy, dealing Ghost property Magic damage to them and all enemies in the surrounding area, and increasing the Magic damage all enemies struck take from all sources for 5 seconds. The Magic Weakness strength is 3% per level of Tornado Kick learned. Deals 50% additional total damage to enemies that are Slowed. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

The user focuses the power of their currently active Blade Enchant into a deadly projectile, consuming the enchant to deal exceptional Ranged Physical damage to a single target. The consumed Blade Enchant affects the attack's properties, and cannot be reactivated for 10 seconds afterward:

* Toxic Blades: The damage is treated as Poison Damage and inflicts the Deadly Poison status for 5 seconds (100% chance). * Flashing Blades: The attack is guaranteed to Crit and ignores all Physical Defense. * Rejuvenating Blades: Reduces all currently active skill cooldowns by 5 seconds. * Peerless Blades: Deals additional damage equal to the user's Current HP.
Damage is increased by 5% ATK per point of the stat granted by the currently active Blade Enchant.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user draws on the power of the evil spirits surrounding them, dividing their strength between their allies to protect them from harm. Consumes all of the user's Spirits to grant a Barrier to all party members in a 31x31 area, lasting 5 seconds. The Barrier's strength is Skill Level × Str × Base Level / 100 per Spirit consumed.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

The user draws the power of the evil spirits surrounding them into themselves, turning their malice into their own strength. Consumes all of the user's active Spirits to gain a short bonus to Attack and Magic Attack of 3 Atk/Matk per Spirit consumed.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

The user gathers all of their spiritual might, unleashing it in a massive blast centered on themselves. Deals massive Physical Damage in a 7x7 area around the user, which is increased by 3% per point of Int.
* Iron Fists: this skill deals additional damage equal to 3% per point of Agi and knocks back enemies 7 cells. * Discipline: this skill's cooldown is halved.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT.
Soul Explosion.requires: Spiritual Rupture Lv3, Spiritual Pursuit Lv3

desc: Training in harmonizing oneself with souls of those who have already passed. Increases Hit Rate and reduces Variable Cast Time when equipped with Soul class weapons, and allows the Soul Linker to use all skills regardless of weapon requirements. Soul Linkers cannot use Taekwon Kicks.

Infuses a single ally with arcane magics, fuelling their skills: for a set number of skill casts within 30 seconds, the SP cost of all the targeted ally's skills is reduced to zero. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Calls on a protective spirit to shield the user from harmful magic for 3 seconds, reflecting a single attack back at its source. If this skill ends because it reflected an attack, the user restores 5% of Max SP per level of Counter Kick learned. Has a cast time of 0.25s FCT + 0.25s VCT.
Costs 100 SP at all levels.

The user strikes the target with a concentrated blast of spiritual energy that can pass through any armor, dealing additional damage based on the target's Defense. Damage is increased by 1% per point of Intelligence. If the user is under the Iron Fists status, this skill also inflicts the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds and deals additional damage of 1% per point of Agility. If the user is under the Discipline status, the cooldown is halved.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Calls on a vengeful soul to suppress an enemy, dealing Ghost property Magic damage with a chance to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds. The Slow chance is 30%, plus 10% per level of Axe Kick learned. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user unleashes a blast of spiritual energy in all directions, damaging all enemies in a wide area around them. Damage is increased by 2% per point of Intelligence. If the user is under the Iron Fists status, this skill also inflicts the Stun status for 3 seconds and deals additional damage of 2% per point of Agility. If the user is under the Discipline status, the cooldown is halved. This skill consumes the Iron Fists and Discipline statuses, but does not grant them.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
Soul Quake.requires: Soul Piercer Lv3, Spiritual Lash Lv3

desc: Calls on a protective spirit that feeds off the user's SP to rapidly restore HP to an ally over time for 5 seconds. The SP consumed is 15% per second, reduced by 1% per level of Roundhouse Kick learned. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user draws on the power of the evil spirits around them, transforming their malice into healing power to sustain them and their allies in combat. Consumes all of the user's active Spirits to recover HP for the targeted ally. The amount healed is Skill Level × Int × Base Level / 100 per Spirit consumed.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

The user connects their soul to that of the target foe, directly siphoning their magical energy. Regenerates SP equal to 1% of the enemy's remaining HP per level, then inflicts the Breach status for 10 seconds (100% chance). Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Costs no SP, with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
Enters a state of extreme focus, increasing the user's ASPD by 20 for 5 seconds and fully refreshing the cooldowns of Slash, Brilliant Strike, and Holy Cross. Requires a Spear or Two-Handed Spear.
Costs 25 SP at all levels.
Increases the damage and Hit Rate of Spears and Two-Handed Spears.

Lashes out with the spear at a distant target, striking them and all enemies between them and the caster. Has a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds, and deals extra damage to enemies that are already Vulnerable. Requires a Spear or Two-Handed Spear.
Has a base cooldown of 6 seconds at all levels.

Summons a wraith from beyond the grave to lash out at a target, dealing Ghost property Physical damage to them and all enemies in the area, leaving an open wound that increases Physical damage they take from all sources for 5 seconds. The Physical Weakness strength is 3% per level of Tornado Kick learned. Deals 50% additional total damage to enemies that are Vulnerable. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

Unleashes a burst of spectral energy, striking a targeted enemy with Ghost property Physical damage and a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. The Vulnerable chance is 30%, plus 10% per level of Axe Kick learned. If an even level of the skill is cast, the target is knocked back 5 cells. Has a cast time of 0.25s FCT + 0.25s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user pulls their own soul closer to the realm of the dead, turning themselves into a conduit that allows power from beyond the grave to flow back into the world of the living. For 5 seconds, constantly drains the user's HP while restoring SP to a targeted ally. The HP consumed is 15% per second, reduced by 1% per level of Roundhouse Kick learned. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user shifts themselves out of the realm of the living for 3 seconds, becoming immune to Physical damage for a single hit. If this skill ends because it blocked an attack, the user restores 5% of Max HP per level of Counter Kick learned. Has a cast time of 0.25s FCT + 0.25s VCT.
Costs 100 SP at all levels.

The user casts a spell that nullifies and consumes incoming magic for 2 seconds. Any magic directly targeting the user fails, regenerating a small amount of SP and removing all cast time from the user's next spell.
Costs 25 SP at all levels.

Perfection through balance. The user focuses on maintaining perfect balance in all things, fighting in a steady rhythm that maximizes their staying power. Activates the Spiritual Cadence status for 10 minutes. While active, whenever the user gains the Discipline or Iron Fists status, if it replaces the opposite status, the stack count of Spiritual Cadence increases by 1; if it replaces a copy of the same status, the stack count is reduced to zero. For each stack, the user's Agility and Intelligence are increased by 1, and they regenerate 1% of Max HP and SP every 5 seconds.
Costs 150 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user focuses their spiritual energy into a physical projectile, launching it at a distant enemy. Damage is increased by 1% per point of Intelligence. If the user is under the Iron Fists status, this skill also inflicts the Slow status for 5 seconds and deals additional damage of 1% per point of Agility. If the user is under the Discipline status, the cooldown is halved.
Has a base cooldown of 8 seconds at all levels.

The user wields their spiritual energy to hurl themselves at a distant foe, using their own body as a projectile. Teleports to a distant target, then deals Ranged Physical Damage that is increased by 2% per point of Int.

* Iron Fists: this skill has a chance to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds, grants double the level of Discipline, and deals additional damage equal to 2% per point of Agi. * Discipline: this skill's cooldown is halved.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.

The user trains in the spiritual arts of the Monk, enabling them to more easily perceive and manipulate their own spiritual energies. Increases the damage of all Spirit skills. Whenever the user casts a Spirit skill, they gain the Discipline status for 10 seconds; while under this status, the next Combo skill used will be cast at the same level as the skill that triggered this status, assuming it is higher.

The user focuses their spiritual energy on the targeted location, causing it to explode and inflict Ranged Physical Damage on all enemies in a 7x7 area. This skill deals additional damage equal to 2% per point of Int.

* Iron Fists: this skill also has a chance to inflict the Bleeding status for 5 seconds, grants double the level of Discipline, and deals additional damage equal to 2% per point of Agi. * Discipline: this skill's cooldown is halved.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.

The user conjures an evil spirit to attack the targeted enemy, dealing Ghost Property Physical Damage and attempting to inflict the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. Casting this skill generates 1 Spirit.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
The user conjures an evil spirit to attack the targeted enemy, dealing Ghost Property Magic Damage and attempting to inflict the Breach status for 5 seconds. Casting this skill generates 1 Spirit.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

The user unleashes a hail of gunfire with their Gatling Gun, saturating a wide area with bullets. Rapidly fires at all enemies in the target area, hitting 10 times in quick succession but with a greatly reduced Accuracy rate. Each enemy within the targeted area can be struck by each volley, but the Hit chance is calculated separately for each enemy and each hit. The chance to hit is increased by the level of the skill, but is unaffected by the user's Hit Rate or the enemy's Flee. Each hit has a chance to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds.
Requires a Gatling Gun in the sub-weapon slot.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 3s VCT.

The user hones their instincts for dirty fighting, taking every battlefield advantage and leaving their opponent no opportunity to fight back. For the duration, the cooldowns of all of the user's skills are reduced by 50%. If the user takes damage from any skill, the status ends early. This effect stacks with other Rogue Instincts.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.
The user summons three Mirages around their current location, immediately maximizing their combat potential.
Costs 50 SP at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Stalking Mirage.requires: Deadly Mirage Lv3, Fading Mirage Lv3, Treacherous Mirage Lv3

desc: Creates a powerful burst of static electricity on the targeted area, dealing a small amount of Wind property damage with a high chance of inflicting the Sleep status. The debuff duration is 5 seconds.

Creates an electrically charged zone for 5 seconds, struck repeatedly by lightning every 0.5 seconds, dealing rapid Wind property damage over time with 30% additional final damage against Sleeping or Dazed enemies. Applies the Wind Affinity status on the user for 30 seconds: while active, all Wind property Magic gains increased Magic Defense Pierce. Only one Affinity can be active at a time. Damage is increased by 0.5% MATK per point of Agi. Has a cast time of 4s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
The user becomes able to face down any threat, powering through incoming damage and surviving where others would fall. Improves the user's Neutral resistance and potion effectiveness.
The user launches themselves at a distant enemy up to 7 cells away, striking them for Physical damage. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Dex.

* If cast while Stellar Blessing is active, the attack repeats against another random nearby enemy two more times; if fewer than three enemies are in range, the same enemy can be struck more than once. * If used during Axe Stance, this skill pierces all elemental resistances of the target. * If used during Tornado Stance, each attack splashes in a 5x5 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user infuses themselves with the ever-present light of the Stars for 10 minutes, granting them enhanced Hit and Defense Pierce, while also increasing their resistance to the Poison and Slow statuses. Defense Pierce gained from this skill counts as card-like Defense Pierce for stacking purposes. While this Alignment is active, Axe Kick and Tornado Kick deal additional total damage of 1% per point of the user's Dex. Does not stack with other Cosmic Alignments.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the Stars, striking a single target for moderate Physical damage and briefly Marking them for 5 seconds. The damage of this skill is increased by 3% Atk per point of Dex. Marked targets have their Defense reduced; this reduction stacks additively with item-based Defense Pierce.

* Solar Heat: the damage is treated as Burning Damage, but bonuses to Burning Damage are significantly reduced (33% of the bonus is applied). * Lunar Protection: the attack gains 20% Life Steal. * Umbral Veil: the attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate.
Has a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the Stars, calling a barrage of meteors to their own position, damaging and Marking all enemies around them for 5 seconds. The damage of this skill is increased by 3% Atk per point of Dex. Marked targets have their Defense reduced; this reduction stacks additively with item-based Defense Pierce.

* Solar Heat: the damage is treated as Burning Damage, but bonuses to Burning Damage are significantly reduced (33% of the bonus is applied). * Lunar Protection: the attack gains 10% Life Steal. * Umbral Veil: the attack gains 30 bonus Crit Rate.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT. Has a 9x9 area centered on the user.
Research into the creation and safe use of various drugs and stimulants. Each level reduces the negative side effects of Stimulant skills.

Summons an enormous stone to drop on the target's location, shattering to deal Earth property damage in a 7x7 area. Enemies struck that are already Bleeding take 30% additional final damage; otherwise, this skill attempts to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds. If the user is in Earth Affinity, the damage is treated as Bleeding Damage and the duration of Earth Affinity is refreshed. Damage is increased by 3% MATK per point of Dex. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Deals a modest amount of Earth property damage to a single target.
When cast, this skill takes the level of Magical Attunement instead of it's own level for determining damage, which also gains a bonus based on the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art satus. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, First Art Ends, and Flashing Steel has it's cooldown reset.
All Basic Ninja Arts share a Cooldown.
Has an SP cost of 25 and a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Places a trap on the ground for 10 seconds that repeatedly unleashes bursts of rocky shrapnel every 0.5 seconds, damaging all enemies in a small area around it with a chance to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds. The trap's damage is treated as Ranged Physical, and is also treated as Bleeding Damage. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Invokes the power of the Perthro Rune, the rune of Destiny, to strike an enemy with explosive force, creating a shockwave that damages all enemies in a 7x7 area around the first target. If the original target is Bleeding, Burning, or Vulnerable, those statuses are spread to all enemies struck by the blast, with a duration of 1 second per level of Rune Research. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Int. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Conjures a blizzard at the target location, repeatedly striking all enemies within with Water property damage and attempting to inflict the Chilled status for 5 seconds. Damage is increased by 2% MATK per point of Vitality. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 2s VCT, plus an additional 0.15s FCT + 0.5s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
Delivers a flurry of wild slashes, dealing devastating damage to a single enemy. Deals 50% additional final damage to Bleeding enemies. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Luck.
* If used during Vanguard Stance, its cooldown is halved. * If used during Warden Stance, the user gains the Endure effect for 3 seconds.
Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of the stat granted by the active Stance. Requires a One or Two-Handed Sword.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user summons Ardor, the spirit of indomitable flame, to aid them in combat. While active, Ardor grants additional Magic Defense Pierce to all of the user's Fire property Magic, but the user's Water Resistance is reduced. Summoned spirits are not targeted by monsters and do not attack or use skills of their own accord, instead, they echo their summoner: offensive Sorcerer skills trigger an Attack Skill from the spirit, and supportive Sorcerer skills trigger a Support Skill. His stats are based on the user's Base Level, and his skills scale with the level of this skill and the user's Luck. Summoning a new spirit dismisses any other active spirit. Has a cast time of 5s FCT.
Costs 500 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. The summon lasts until replaced or dismissed.
Summon Ardor.requires: Agni's Wrath Lv3, Agni's Heat Lv3

desc: The user summons Diluvio, the spirit of the endless ocean, to aid them in combat. While active, Diluvio grants additional Magic Defense Pierce to all of the user's Water property Magic, but the user's Wind Resistance is reduced. Summoned spirits are not targeted by monsters and do not attack or use skills of their own accord, instead, they echo their summoner: offensive Sorcerer skills trigger an Attack Skill from the spirit, and supportive Sorcerer skills trigger a Support Skill. Her stats are based on the user's Base Level, and her skills scale with the level of this skill and the user's Vitality. Summoning a new spirit dismisses any other active spirit. Has a cast time of 5s FCT.
Costs 500 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. The summon lasts until replaced or dismissed.
Summon Diluvio.requires: Aqua's Breath Lv3, Aqua's Relief Lv3

desc: Summons a Forest Sprite to fight for the user for 15 seconds, plus 2 seconds per level of Flora Specialization. Forest Sprites are ranged combatants that use a mixture of offensive and supportive skills (Floral Lance, Blessed Dust, and Lethargy). Their stats are influenced by the caster's stats, Flora Specialization level, and Base Level; their Hit equals the caster's Hit, and their Crit is half the caster's at the time of summoning. They respond to the Support, Move, and Return Commands. While alive, Forest Sprites passively halve the cooldown of the caster's Demonstration. Only one Forest Sprite can be present at a time, and it cannot be summoned alongside a Wooden Warrior. Monsters will not target summoned Flora. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

Summons a Cursed Tree to exert its influence on the area around the user for 10 seconds, plus 2 seconds per level of Flora Specialization. Cursed Trees do not move or attack, but occasionally immobilize enemies and enhance allies in a wide area around them (using the skills Entangling Roots and Mass Overcharge). In addition, any Wooden Warriors and Forest Sprites in the area of a Cursed Tree enter a berserk state, casting skills more frequently and dealing more damage. Though it will not move of its own accord, the Cursed Tree responds to the Move and Return Commands. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 2s VCT.
Summon Infernal Tree.requires: Summon Warrior Lv5, Summon Fairy Lv5

desc: The user summons Procella, the spirit of the storm and gale, to aid them in combat. While active, Procella grants additional Magic Defense Pierce to all of the user's Wind property Magic, but the user's Earth Resistance is reduced. Summoned spirits are not targeted by monsters and do not attack or use skills of their own accord, instead, they echo their summoner: offensive Sorcerer skills trigger an Attack Skill from the spirit, and supportive Sorcerer skills trigger a Support Skill. Her stats are based on the user's Base Level, and her skills scale with the level of this skill and the user's Agility. Summoning a new spirit dismisses any other active spirit. Has a cast time of 5s FCT.
Costs 500 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. The summon lasts until replaced or dismissed.
Summon Procella.requires: Ventus's Gale Lv3, Ventus's Haste Lv3

desc: The user summons Terra Motus, the spirit of earth and stone, to aid them in combat. While active, Terra Motus grants additional Magic Defense Pierce to all of the user's Earth property Magic, but the user's Fire Resistance is reduced. Summoned spirits are not targeted by monsters and do not attack or use skills of their own accord, instead, they echo their summoner: offensive Sorcerer skills trigger an Attack Skill from the spirit, and supportive Sorcerer skills trigger a Support Skill. His stats are based on the user's Base Level, and his skills scale with the level of this skill and the user's Dexterity. Summoning a new spirit dismisses any other active spirit. Has a cast time of 5s FCT.
Costs 500 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. The summon lasts until replaced or dismissed.
Summon Terra Motus.requires: Terra's Fangs Lv3, Terra's Shield Lv3

desc: Summons a Wooden Warrior to fight for the user for 15 seconds, plus 2 seconds per level of Flora Specialization. Wooden Warriors are melee combatants that deal increased damage to enemies suffering from Bleeding and Vulnerable, and know the skills Pierce, Spear Stab, and Brandish Spear. Their stats are influenced by the caster's stats, Flora Specialization level, and Base Level; their Hit equals the caster's Hit, and their Crit is half the caster's at the time of summoning. They respond to the Attack, Move, and Return Commands. While alive, Wooden Warriors passively halve the cooldown of the caster's Acid Terror. Only one Wooden Warrior can be present at a time, and it cannot be summoned alongside a Forest Sprite. Monsters will not target summoned Flora. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.

The user draws on the power of the Celestial Lights, striking with the light of the Sun. Deals Physical damage to all enemies in a 5x5 area around the target, with additional damage equal to 1% Atk per point of Int and Dex.

* No Celestial State: has a chance to inflict the Burning status for 5 seconds. * Rising Sun: has a chance to inflict the Internal Bleeding status for 5 seconds. * High Noon: the damage of this skill is treated as half Burning and half Bleeding.
This skill will fail if the user's Celestial State is in Nightfall.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Increases the damage and Hit rate of One-handed Swords.

Throws a volley of arrows at a target, carefully timed to synchronize with the user's performance. Deals 10% additional damage per Rhythm level, and extends the duration of the current Rhythm level by 2 seconds. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Agility. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 0.3s FCT + 0.7s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.
Synchronic Strike.requires: Bard: Musical Mastery Lv1 / Dancer: Dancing Dexterity Lv1

desc: Creates an alchemical shield that acts autonomously to protect the target, giving them a chance to block any physical attacks and improving their Magic Defense. Magic Defense is increased by 2 per level of Enhancement Research. Shift + Click to apply to Homunculi.
Costs 20 SP at all levels.

The user quickly dashes to the targeted location, refreshing the duration of all Preparation Counters after stopping. If the user has three Preparation Counters, it also inflicts the Slow status for 5 seconds (100% chance) on all enemies around the user before moving. Can only move to locations the user has direct line of sight to, and cannot move through obstacles. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 25 SP with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
A mark of true dedication to the art of Taekwon Do.
Increases the Job Level Cap of the user, as well as the damage of ALL attacks and Kick Skills.
The quest to learn this skill begins in Payon's Archer Village. Learning this skill PERMANENTLY blocks the ability to change Jobs. This CANNOT be undone.

Summons an enchanted wind to aid the party, hastening their movements. Increases the Movement Speed and Flee Rate of all party members. Movement Speed is further increased by 1% per 10 points of Agi, and Flee by 1 per 5 points of Agi. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 2s VCT.

The user calls on the spirits of nature to protect the targeted ally, bestowing on them a protective talisman. Grants the targeted ally a Barrier for 5 seconds. The closer the user's AP is to 100, the stronger the Barrier becomes, modified by -1% per point of AP above or below 100.
* AP within 50 of 100: also cures the Bleeding, Burning, and Poison statuses. * AP within 10 of 100: also heals the target for the same amount of HP as the Barrier.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Talisman of Protection.requires: Ritual of Invocation Lv1, Ritual of Binding Lv1

desc: The user calls on the spirits of nature to bless the targeted ally, bestowing on them a destructive talisman. For the skill's duration, the targeted ally's Vulnerable and Breach Potency are increased by 30%, modified by -0.3% per point of the user's AP above or below 100.

* AP within 50 of 100: the target is also protected from Blind, Slow, and Slowcast for the duration. * AP within 10 of 100: the target's Bleeding, Burning, and Poison Damage are also increased for the duration.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Talisman of War.requires: Ritual of Invocation Lv1, Ritual of Binding Lv1

desc: Draws a tarot card for the targeted enemy, bestowing on them the curse of Death. Inflicts direct damage equal to 40% of the user's Max HP per Rhythm level; this damage is neither Physical nor Magical, and the Max HP bonus is capped at 50,000 HP. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.
Costs 100 SP at all levels.
Tarot Card: Death.requires: Tarot Card: The Fool Lv5, Tarot Card: The Hanged Man Lv5, Tarot Card: The Tower Lv5, Tarot Card: The Devil Lv5

desc: Draws a tarot card for the targeted ally, bestowing on them the blessing of Strength. For 1 second per Rhythm level (at the time the buff was applied), all Physical skills used by the target deal additional damage, added directly to the skill's Damage Ratio. This skill's effect is reduced when applied to Devastating Descant or Ravaging Rainstorm. Does not stack with Tarot Card: The Magician. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Draws a tarot card for the targeted enemy, bestowing on them the curse of the Devil. After a short delay, the target explodes, dealing Hybrid damage and inflicting a status effect (100% chance, 5 seconds) on all enemies in the area around them, based on the user's Rhythm level:
* At Rhythm 1 or 2, inflicts Severe Burning. * At Rhythm 3 or 4, inflicts Deadly Poison. * At Rhythm 5, inflicts Internal Bleeding.
Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Draws a tarot card for the targeted enemy, bestowing on them the curse of the Fool. For the duration, skills cast by the target have a 20% chance per Rhythm level (at the time the debuff was applied) to fail. Once a skill fails, the effect ends. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.
Draws a tarot card for the targeted enemy, bestowing on them the curse of the Hanged Man. Applies a disabling status based on the user's current Rhythm level:
* At Rhythm 1 or 2, inflicts the Slow status for 5 seconds. * At Rhythm 3 or 4, inflicts the Immobilize status for 2 seconds. * At Rhythm 5, inflicts the Stun status for 2 seconds.
Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP at all levels.

Draws a tarot card for the targeted ally, bestowing on them the blessing of the High Priestess. For 10 seconds, the next few times that ally would take damage, they are immediately healed for 4% of Max HP per Rhythm level (at the time the buff was applied). The healing caused by this skill is not affected by Healing Power. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

Draws a tarot card for the targeted ally, bestowing on them the blessing of the Lovers. Cleanses the Bleeding, Burning, Poison, Blind, Vulnerable, Slow, and Chilled statuses from the target, then makes them immune to those effects for 3 seconds, plus 1 second per Rhythm level at the time the buff was applied. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP at all levels.

Draws a tarot card for the targeted ally, bestowing on them the blessing of the Magician. For 1 second per Rhythm level (at the time the buff was applied), all Magical attacks used by the target deal additional damage, added directly to the skill's Damage Ratio. This skill's effect is reduced when applied to Devastating Descant. Does not stack with Tarot Card: Strength. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Draws a tarot card for the targeted enemy, bestowing on them the curse of the Tower. Inflicts Hybrid damage to the target based on the property of the user's equipped arrow, hitting once per Rhythm level; the skill misses if the Rhythm level is zero. Has a cast time of 0.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Costs 35 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Draws a tarot card for the user, bestowing on them the blessing of the Wheel of Fortune. Instantly reduces all active cooldowns by 5 seconds per Rhythm level. This skill's own cooldown can never be reduced. Has a cast time of 3s VCT.
Costs 100 SP at all levels.
Tarot Card: Wheel of Fortune.requires: Tarot Card: The Magician Lv5, Tarot Card: Strength Lv5, Tarot Card: The High Priestess Lv5, Tarot Card: The Lovers Lv5

desc: Invokes the power of the Uruz Rune, the rune of Freedom. Rapidly restores health to the user every second for 5 seconds, plus a bonus 100 HP per second for each level of Rune Research. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on spirits of earth to pierce their foes, dealing Earth property damage in a 7x7 targeted area. The damage is increased by the user's bonuses to Summoned Entity Damage, and by 2% MATK per point of Dex. If Terra Motus (Summon Terra Motus) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use an Attack Skill. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on spirits of earth to shield their party members: creates a barrier around all party members for 10 seconds that absorbs half of the damage they take, up to a maximum absorption amount. That maximum is increased by 1% per point of the user's Summoned Entity HP bonus, and is affected by all bonuses to Barrier Potency. If Terra Motus (Summon Terra Motus) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use a Support Skill. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Temporarily applies a second Guillotine Cross poison to the user's weapon, stacking with any others from Fatal Blades or other Assassin Blade Enchants. The poison applied is based on the level cast, but its strength is always determined by the level of Thirsting Fangs learned. While active, the user cannot activate any Blade Enchant skills, but previous Blade Enchants are not removed. The skill fails if the chosen poison is already active. The poisons must be crafted.
Costs 25 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
The user launches a three-stage attack, having different effects depending on the state of the target:

* Attempts to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds. * If the target is already Slowed, instead inflicts the Vulnerable status for 5 seconds. * If the target is already Vulnerable, instead inflicts the Stun status for 2 seconds.
Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Strength. Requires a Bow. Has a cast time of 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 7 seconds at all levels.
Quickly throws the equipped Huuma Shuriken at a target, dealing heavy damage. The damage is heavily influenced by the user's STR and INT.

Casting this skill grants Second Art. If First Art or Third Art are active, this skill splashes in a 3x3 area. If both are active, it splashes in a 7x7 area instead, Third Art ends, and Basic Ninja Arts have their cooldowns reset.
This skill cannot be learned normally, it is only granted from equipping Shurikens.
Has an SP cost of 5 and a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels. Has a 0.5FCT + 0.5VCT cast time at all levels.
Quickly throws the equipped Kunai at a target, dealing moderate damage. The damage is heavily influenced by the user's STR and INT.

Casting this skill grants Second Art. If First Art or Third Art are active, this skill has a 50% chance to inflict the equipped Kunai's status effect. If both are active, the chance becomes 100% instead, Third Art ends, and Basic Ninja Arts have their cooldowns reset.
This skill cannot be learned normally, it is only granted from equipping Kunai.
Has an SP cost of 10 and a cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Quickly throws the equipped Shuriken at a target, dealing minor damage. The damage is heavily influenced by the user's STR and INT.

Casting this skill grants Second Art. If First Art or Third Art are active, this skill repeats twice. If both are active, it repeats four times instead, Third Art ends, and Basic Ninja Arts have their cooldowns reset.
This skill cannot be learned normally, it is only granted from equipping Shurikens.
Has an SP cost of 5 and a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Training in the use of Throwing Weapons unique to the Ninja class. Each level of this Mastery increases the skill level gained by equipping throwing weapons. Throwing Skills calculate their damage based on the user's DEX and the ATK of their offhand weapon only. They still receive the effects of cards in the user's mainhand weapon.
Deals a large amount of Wind property Magical damage in a 7x7 area around the caster with a chance to inflict the Sleep status.
When cast, takes the level of Advanced Ninjutsu Mastery instead of it's own level for determining damage, with an additional bonus that scales with the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art Status. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, Second Art ends, and Departing Shadow has it's cooldown reset.
Has an SP cost of 40 and a cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
All Advanced Ninja Arts share a cooldown.

The user leverages their ultimate mastery over the workings of the world to accelerate time, pushing it forward for their party: immediately reduces the active cooldowns of all party members by a fixed amount. This skill's own cooldown can never be reduced. Has a cast time of 5s FCT.
Costs 250 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.
Time Shift.requires: Free Cast Lv3, Soul Siphon Lv3

desc: The user conjures an evil spirit to torment the targeted enemy and all enemies in a 7x7 area around them, dealing Ghost Property Physical Damage in an area and attempting to inflict the Blind status for 5 seconds. Casting this skill generates 3 Spirits.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.

The user conjures an evil spirit to torment the enemies around the target, dealing Ghost Property Magic Damage in a 7x7 area and attempting to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds. Casting this skill generates 3 Spirits.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Unleashes a wide-reaching kick that strikes all enemies in a 5x5 area around the user.

Using this skill grants the Tornado Stance for 5 seconds, during which time all kicks hit enemies in a 5x5 AoE around their target. Tornado stance ends when any other Stance ends or when Tornado Kick is cast again.
Has a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
Tornado Kick.requires: Martial Precision Lv3, Martial Agility Lv3

desc: Enchants the user's weapons with a toxic coating, increasing the potency of the Poison status inflicted by the user and adding Agility scaling to all Assassin skills. Does not stack with other Blade Enchants.
Costs 20 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user unleashes a blast of toxic air across a 9x9 area, dealing Poison property Physical damage (treated as Poison Status damage) with a chance to inflict the Poison status for 5 seconds. If the user is in Toxic Shadow, the skill inflicts Deadly Poison instead and the chance is doubled. Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Creates a short-lived cloud of toxic gas over a 7x7 area for 5 seconds, dealing Physical Poison property damage (treated as Poison Status damage) every second, with a chance to inflict the Poison status for 5 seconds. If the user is in Toxic Shadow, the interval between hits is halved. Damage is increased by 1% ATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user deploys a trap that lasts 15 seconds and triggers on contact, dealing Poison property damage with a high chance to inflict the Poison status for 5 seconds on all enemies in a 5x5 area. Damage is greatly improved by the user's Agility, increased by 3% ATK per point of Agility. Has a cast time of 3.5s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user imbibes a powerful toxin that deals constant damage to them over time, but in exchange massively increases their physical abilities: while active, the user gains bonus Movement Speed and Attack, and all Toxin skills are enhanced. The self-damage is treated as Poison Status damage, but cannot be cured or resisted, is not increased by the user's bonuses to Poison Damage, and does not trigger effects that require Poison.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.

Strikes an enemy and triggers any toxins in their system to violently explode. Deals moderate Poison property Physical damage to a single target, but if that target is suffering from Poison or Deadly Poison, it instead triggers an explosion that deals massive damage to them and all enemies in a 7x7 area. The base damage is enhanced by the strength of the target's Poison (Poison Tick × Skill Level / 30); if both statuses are present, Poison is used. All damage is treated as Poison Status damage. If the user is in Toxic Shadow, the explosion triggers even against unpoisoned targets. Damage is increased by 5% ATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 1.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
Toxic Shock.requires: Toxic Breath Lv3, Toxic Surge Lv3, Toxic Cloud Lv3

desc: Amplifies the Poison status currently affecting a single target. If the target is Poisoned, they take a burst of Physical Poison property damage (treated as Poison Status damage), then the strength of their Poison is increased by (2 × Luk) per level and its duration extended by 5 seconds. A target's Poison can only be enhanced once, regardless of the cause. This skill does not interact with Deadly Poison, and does nothing if the target is not Poisoned, unless the user is in Toxic Shadow, in which case it can be used on unpoisoned targets. Damage is increased by 3% ATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.
The user instantly teleports to the targeted location. The skill will fail if there is no clear path to the destination.
Costs 100 SP at all levels.

The user enters a state of extreme focus, enabling them to construct and deploy traps with unprecedented speed. Removes the Fixed Cast Time of all Trap Skills entirely (100% reduction) for 5 minutes, while also increasing the duration of statuses inflicted by them. This skill does not stack with Marksman's Focus.
Costs 30 SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.

The user wraps themselves in a bewitching illusion, causing enemy attacks to fail to land. When cast, the user creates a Mirage at their location. Then, for 3 seconds, the next time the user would get hit by a Skill Attack, that attack misses and the user generates another Mirage at their present location. If the user has no Ninja Arts active, they also gain the Third Art status when the skill is first cast. Up to three Mirages can be active at a given time.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 2s VCT.
Improves the user's ability to utilize the Hiding skill, allowing movement while hiding and increasing the skill's duration.
Increases the damage and Hit Rate of Two-Handed Swords.

The user wields darkness like a blade, lashing out at enemies with the emptiness of the deep cosmos. Deals damage in a 3x3 area around the targeted location. Damage is increased by 2% ATK per point of Agi.

* If cast while Umbral Veil is active, the attack is guaranteed to Crit. * If used during Tornado Stance, the skill area increases to 7x7. * If used during Roundhouse Stance, this skill's cooldown is halved.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the Cosmic Shadow, unleashing a wave of destructive darkness to strike and Blind all enemies in a 9x9 area around them for 5 seconds. This skill has 30 bonus Crit Rate, and its damage is increased by 3% Atk per point of Agi.

* Solar Heat: the damage is treated as Burning Damage, but bonuses to Burning Damage are significantly reduced (33% of the bonus is applied). * Lunar Protection: the attack gains 10% Life Steal. * Stellar Blessing: the attack ignores the target's Defense.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the Cosmic Shadow, lashing out to strike all enemies in a 9x9 area around them. This skill has 30 bonus Crit Rate, and its damage is increased by 3% Atk per point of Agi.

* Solar Heat: the damage is treated as Burning Damage, but bonuses to Burning Damage are significantly reduced (33% of the bonus is applied). * Lunar Protection: the attack gains 10% Life Steal. * Stellar Blessing: the attack ignores the target's Defense.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user shrouds themselves with the infinite darkness of the cosmos for 10 minutes, taking on its cruel and ruthless nature. Increases the user's Crit Rate and Crit Damage, while also increasing their resistance to the Blind and Stun statuses. While this Alignment is active, Tornado Kick and Roundhouse Kick deal additional total damage of 1% per point of the user's Agi. Does not stack with other Cosmic Alignments.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user focuses inward, drawing on a supernatural resilience from within themselves. For 10 seconds, all damage taken by the user is greatly reduced, but they cannot gain the Iron Fists or Discipline statuses.
Costs 100% of the user's current SP with a base cooldown of 60 seconds. Has a cast time of 2s FCT.

The user releases themselves of all worldly attachments, freeing themselves from the struggles of the moment and allowing them to focus solely on the enemy before them. Consumes the Iron Fists and Discipline statuses to heal themselves.
* Iron Fists: if consumed, the user recovers 5% of their Max HP per Iron Fists level. * Discipline: if consumed, the user recovers 5% of their Max SP per Discipline level.
Costs 30 SP at all levels. Has a cast time of 1s FCT.
The user unloads their revolvers into the targeted enemy, dealing significant damage and attempting to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds.
* Revolver Specialization: this skill consumes the target's Crimson Marker to immediately refresh its cooldown. * Otherwise: this skill inflicts the Crimson Marker status.
This skill generates 1 Grenade, and is refreshed by Rapid Reload if you have a Revolver equipped. Requires a Revolver.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user shifts into an offensive stance for 5 minutes, optimizing their damage and accuracy at the expense of defense. Increases the user's Hit Rate and adds Agility scaling to all Lord Knight skills. Requires a Two-Handed Weapon. Does not stack with Warden Stance.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Consumes any poison suffered by the target to heal the user, with the amount based on the strength of the target's Poison and the level of the skill used (Poison Tick Damage × Skill Level). If the target is suffering from both Poison and Deadly Poison, only Poison will be consumed. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 30 SP with a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

Places a trap on the ground for 10 seconds that repeatedly unleashes bursts of toxic gas every 0.5 seconds, damaging all enemies in a small area around it with a chance to inflict the Poison status for 5 seconds. The trap's damage is treated as Ranged Physical, and is also treated as Poison Damage. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on spirits of wind to blow away their foes, dealing Wind property damage to all enemies in a straight line between them and their target. The damage is increased by the user's bonuses to Summoned Entity Damage, and by 2% MATK per point of Agi. If Procella (Summon Procella) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use an Attack Skill. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user calls on spirits of wind to hasten their party: for 30 seconds, all party members gain increased Attack Speed (plus 0.1 per 1% of the user's Summoned Entity HP bonus) and reduced Variable Cast Times (plus 1% per 2% of the user's Summoned Entity HP bonus). If Procella (Summon Procella) is present, this skill's cooldown is halved. Casting this skill triggers the currently active Elemental Spirit to use a Support Skill. Has a cast time of 3s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 20 seconds at all levels.

Invites the soul of a bloodthirsty warrior to inhabit the user's body, drawing on a portion of its strength. For 5 minutes, converts a portion of the user's Magic Attack into Physical Attack, and increases the user's Crit Rate by 1 per 3 points of Int and Crit Damage by 1% per 3 points of Dex. Only one Possession can be active at a time. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

The user recites an enchanted verse, laced with deadly magic to hurt the enemy without breaking the rhythm of their performance. Deals 10% additional damage per Rhythm level, and extends the duration of the current Rhythm level by 2 seconds. Damage is increased by 1% MATK per point of Luck. Requires an Instrument or Whip. Has a cast time of 0.3s FCT + 0.7s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 3 seconds at all levels.
Vicious Verse.requires: Bard: Musical Mastery Lv1 / Dancer: Dancing Dexterity Lv1

desc: Focuses the power of the void, consuming 19% of the user's Max HP per level cast to condense it into Void Spheres, a resource used to empower other Warlock skills. Up to five Void Spheres can be held at one time, regardless of whether this skill has been learned. Void Spheres last until they are consumed, the user is killed, or the user logs out. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 60 seconds at all levels.

The user channels the power of the void, infusing it into their own body. For 5 minutes, converts all Magic damage dealt by the user to a different property based on the level of Void Infusion cast, each with an associated demerit (see below). Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 100 SP with a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

rows: The user's Magic Defense Pierce becomes 0
The user loses 5% of Max HP every 5 seconds
The user's SP Regen is halved

desc: Invokes a burst of blazing magical energy underneath the target's feet, dealing Fire property Magic damage in a 7x7 area with 30% additional final damage against Burning enemies. Applies the Fire Affinity status on the user for 30 seconds: while active, all Fire property Magic gains increased Magic Defense Pierce. Only one Affinity can be active at a time. Damage is increased by 5% MATK per point of Luck. Has a cast time of 4s FCT + 2s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.
The user summons a barrage of lightning bolts to strike the targeted location, dealing Wind Property Damage to all enemies in the area.
* First Art: this skill's Fixed Cast Time is removed. * Second Art: this skill's Variable Cast Time is removed. * Third Art: all active Mirages immediately cast Thunderous Surge at Level 5.
This skill deals additional damage equal to 5% Matk per point of Str and Dex. Affects a 9x9 area.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels. Has a cast time of 2s FCT + 3s VCT.

The user fires a volley of arrows at a distant target, hitting 2 times per Rhythm level. If the user's Rhythm level is zero, this skill will miss. Damage is increased by 0.2% ATK per point of Agility. Has a cast time of 1.5s FCT + 0.5s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user shifts into a defensive stance for 5 minutes, optimizing their ability to survive and protect their allies at the cost of raw damage. Reduces all damage taken by the user and adds Vitality scaling to all Lord Knight skills. Requires a Two-Handed Weapon. Does not stack with Vanguard Stance.
Costs 50 SP with a base cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

The user takes a defensive stance for 5 seconds, blocking the next Physical attack against them. If an attack is successfully blocked, the user enters the Counter State for 5 seconds and the cooldowns of Rupture and Counter Slash are refreshed. Requires a Dagger.
Costs 35 SP at all levels.

Combines certain materials to create a Weapon Modification device. These modifications can be applied to most weapons, overwriting their Random Options and replacing them with more focused bonuses. The level of this skill improves the effectiveness of Weapon Modifications for the user, but has no effect on success rate or the quality of rolls received. Each craft succeeds 100% of the time and produces 1 to 5 devices at random. Recipes for Weapon Modifications must be found in the world.

Utilizing their mastery in weapon crafting, the user modifies their weapon to fine-tune it against each opponent, removing all size penalties and increasing the Critical Damage of autoattacks for 5 minutes. Requires an Axe or Two-Handed Axe.
Costs 30 SP at all levels.

Reinforces the party's weapons, providing a different beneficial effect depending on the level used. Using this skill above level 1 requires a Weapon Maintenance Kit crafted at the Blacksmith's Guild. Regardless of what level of the skill is cast, the max level learned is used to determine the skill's potency.
Costs 10 SP at all levels.

rows: Neutral property damage +4% per skill level; Weapon ATK +3 per Equipment Maintenance level

desc: The user performs a strangely enervating dance, sapping enemies of the will to pursue them. Enemies approaching the user are inflicted with the Slow status (50% strength) for 10 seconds, with strength increased by 1% per point of the user's Agi. If Rhythm level is Odd, it increases by 1; if Even, it decreases by 1. This skill is exclusive to Dancers. Requires a Whip. Has a cast time of 1s VCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

The user adopts a wild battle stance, passively adding a chance for non-skill attacks to splash in a 5x5 area around the user for 50% ATK; the splash also deals additional damage to the original target of the attack. When activated, the trigger chance is tripled for 5 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 30 seconds at all levels.

Throws a volley of projectiles around the user, gaining different effects based on the equipped Throwing Weapon. The damage deals an additional 3% Atk per point of Str and Int. Affects a 5x5 / 7x7 / 9x9 area (the wider areas coming from the Huuma bonuses below).

* Shuriken: ** First Art or Third Art: repeats once. ** Both: repeats twice, both Arts end, and Shifting Shadow's duration is increased by 1 second per target. ** Second Art only: autocasts Echoing Shadow on all targets struck, then refreshes the cooldowns of Echoing Shadow and Departing Shadow. * Kunai: ** First Art or Third Art: has a 50% chance to inflict the Kunai's status. ** Both: the chance is 100%, both Arts end, and Shifting Shadow's duration is increased by 1 second per target. ** Second Art only: inflicts Vulnerable on all targets struck, then refreshes the cooldowns of Echoing Shadow and Departing Shadow. * Huuma: ** First Art or Third Art: the area of effect is increased. ** Both: the area is increased further, both Arts end, and Shifting Shadow's duration is increased by 1 second per target. ** Second Art only: gains the Endure effect and refreshes the cooldowns of Echoing Shadow and Departing Shadow.
Statuses inflicted last 5 seconds.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Summons a violent gale to whip through the targeted 7x7 location, inflicting Wind property damage over time to all enemies within. Deals 20% increased damage while the caster is under the effects of the Tailwind status. Damage is increased by 0.5% MATK per point of Agility. Only one Land Spell can be active at a time. Has a cast time of 0.2s FCT + 0.4s VCT per skill level.
Has a base cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.

Administers a drug that numbs the target's senses, massively reducing the damage they take from the Bleeding, Burning, and Poison statuses, but reducing their Crit Rate and increasing their Variable Cast Time (side effects reduced by Stimulant Research). If cast at level 3 or higher, also generates one Extort and grants the target the Endure effect for the duration. This skill's duration is 15 seconds per Extort stack the user has, but the stacks are not consumed. Has a cast time of 1s FCT + 1s VCT.
Costs 40 SP with a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Deals a modest amount of Wind property damage to a single target.
When cast, this skill takes the level of Magical Attunement instead of it's own level for determining damage, which also gains a bonus based on the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art satus. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, First Art Ends, and Flashing Steel has it's cooldown reset.
All Basic Ninja Arts share a Cooldown.
Has an SP cost of 25 and a cooldown of 5 seconds at all levels.

Places a trap on the ground for 10 seconds that repeatedly unleashes bursts of razor-sharp wind every 0.5 seconds, damaging all enemies in a small area around it with a chance to inflict the Slow status for 5 seconds. The trap's damage is treated as Ranged Physical, and is also increased by the user's Slow Potency. Has a cast time of 3s FCT.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.

Invokes the power of the Isa Rune, the rune of Ice, to release a blast of icy wind that slices apart all enemies in a 7x7 area, with a chance of leaving them Bleeding for 5 seconds (50% chance, plus 5% per level of Rune Research). The damage is treated as Bleeding Damage, and is increased by 2% ATK per point of Int.
Has a base cooldown of 10 seconds at all levels.
Deals a large amount of Water property Magical damage in a 7x7 area around the caster with a chance to inflict the Chilled status.
When cast, takes the level of Advanced Ninjutsu Mastery instead of it's own level for determining damage, with an additional bonus that scales with the user's STR and DEX.

Casting this skill grants the Third Art Status. If First Art or Second Art are active, this skill has it's Fixed Cast Time removed. If both are active, the entire Cast Time is removed instead, Second Art ends, and Departing Shadow has it's cooldown reset.
Has an SP cost of 40 and a cooldown of 15 seconds at all levels.
All Advanced Ninja Arts share a cooldown.

The user sings a vengeful note, spurring their allies on to bloodshed. All allies within a 25x25 area under the effect of Hypnotic Harmony receive, per Rhythm level consumed: +1 Strength and Vitality, +10% Defense Pierce, and +3% Crit Damage, then have the duration of their Hypnotic Harmony refreshed.
